Fixed Claude in Chrome reporting the extension as not connected when the connection dropped mid-action; Claude now checks the page before repeating an action that may have run - Fixed Remote Control sessions still showing "Limit reached" on other devices after a usage limit was lifted outside the session - Fixed the file card sometimes missing in the Claude iOS app when Claude sent a single file - Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing with no explanation when the server keeps refusing to renew model access: the runner now retries sooner and posts a warning in the session - Fixed `/permissions` in cloud sessions replying only that it isn't available; it now says where the session's rules live and how to change them - Fixed cloud sessions losing session-scoped deny and ask permission rules, such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds, when the session moves to a new worker - Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the session when you typed three messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session - Fixed background tasks that keep running after `/clear` disappearing from the task list in Claude Code on the web until another task started or ended - Fixed hidden commands appearing in the slash command menu of cloud sessions on mobile and web - Fixed a case where `/rewind` could restore or delete a file through a directory symlink - Fixed a case where a `sed` command could skip the permission check in accept-edits and auto mode - Fixed a case where `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` in managed settings was ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway's URL is set only there and server-managed settings can't be fetched - Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command from permission checks - Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and `disallowedTools` entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack`) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version) - Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree - Fixed self-hosted runners: `--trust-workspace false` now also stops hooks in the repository's settings files and skills from running - Fixed a case where idle background sessions started through a shell-exported LLM gateway left the gateway after an update - Fixed help links in `/status` and the auto mode billing notice opening only part of the address when they wrap - Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` was set. Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` not being substituted in a plugin-provided `subagentStatusLine` command, which can now reference the plugin's own scripts - Fixed `claude plugin update` and `/plugin` "Update now" not installing dependencies added by the new plugin version - Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the project - Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto mode no longer skips the prompt - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS` so that settings files can no longer set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment - Changed a session's exact Bash or PowerShell ask rule to be refused, not asked about, when a broader deny rule covers the command - the result reports the effort sent - Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`) - Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends - Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314) - Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew - Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared - Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory - Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home - Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server - Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run - Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects - Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days - Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored - Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary - Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running - Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions - Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step` - Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message - Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited - Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process - Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary - Fixed `/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection - Fixed `/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404 - Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run - Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart - Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes - Fixed variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions - Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed - Fixed a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it - Fixed a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call - Fixed every connection failing when the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr - Fixed workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit - Fixed `/mcp` in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available - Fixed a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call - Fixed the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit - Fixed the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open - Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs - Fixed retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs `claude -p` with no `~/.claude.json` backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one - Fixed the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files - Fixed tokens from `setup-token` being refused at start on machines with `forceLoginOrgUUID`, when the token belongs to a permitted organization - Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551) - Fixed an empty `~/.claude.json` with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing - Fixed the restore command printed for a damaged or missing `~/.claude.json` naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file - Fixed the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in `claude -p` names `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token` - Improved how `~/.claude.json`, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy - Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders - Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema - Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in `/bin/bash` - Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step - Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep - Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal - Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check - Improved unattended runs (`claude -p`, SDK apps) to stop rewriting `~/.claude.json` on every run when nothing in it changed - Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view - Changed subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time" - Changed background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs - Changed subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response - Changed what a mod attaches at `prompt.submit` to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message - Changed `deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name - Changed the `/permissions` rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting - Changed `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out - Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped - Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (`external_account`) credentials file is about to expire - Gateway: Improved the log hints about `listen.trusted_proxies`: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to `X-Forwarded-For` itself - Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access - Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent - Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when `--release-idle-session-min` is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as `0`) - Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: `ok session=…` now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with `reason=…` after `jti=…`, and `nack session=…` ends its fields with `reason=…` after `retryable=…`; update scripts that match `retryable=true:` or `retryable=false:` - Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder - Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)" - [VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute - [VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view - [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails - [Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository - [Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH - [Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden - [Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: `gh run view --log` and `gh api` log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect - [Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again - [Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory - [Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name - [Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in Claude Tag admin setup; pressing Escape in the connect form no longer also closes the Add dialog - [Code Review] Improved the Code Review analytics page to retry once after a server or network failure, then show a Try again banner instead of empty cards

Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps - Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls - Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message - Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval - Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off - Fixed Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which - Fixed Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete - Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting - Fixed self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval - Fixed very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request - Fixed a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages - Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model - Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions - Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download - Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model - Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached - Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task) - Fixed background and cloud sessions started with Ultracode turning it back on at their next start after it had been switched off - Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed - Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters - Fixed background diff refreshes briefly taking the repository's index lock, which could make a git command run at the same moment fail with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists" - Fixed markdown tables jumping between grid and stacked layouts on half-typed rows while streaming, and long tables falling back to raw pipes - Fixed the /resume picker showing the text of CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md as a session's title when the session only ran slash commands - Fixed `/btw` answering from the main conversation when asked from a subagent's open transcript - Fixed pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine doing nothing silently; the prompt now says to copy the file over and paste its path - Fixed `claude remote-control` sessions that failed to start when the session service was slow for a moment: the worker's registration is now retried with growing waits - Fixed model switches over Remote Control that take over 8 seconds getting a "still pending" error instead of the final result - Fixed the `sandbox.excludedCommands` setting description saying listed commands always run outside the sandbox; it now says every command in a call must match an entry - Fixed shell and MCP calls that auto mode, a deny rule or a PreToolUse hook blocked, or that otherwise did not run, reading as if they ran in a collapsed tool group - Fixed sandbox protections not applying to a worktree entered by `claude -p --resume` or `--continue` - Fixed hooks matching Bash not running on shell commands started by the Monitor tool; such hooks can block or ask, but not approve or rewrite those commands - Fixed a settings file excluded with `--setting-sources` still supplying some settings, such as auto mode rules and saved permission consents - Fixed auto mode reporting a call as blocked, and listing it in `/permissions`, when its safety check gave no verdict - Fixed a Claude apps gateway Vertex upstream hanging for minutes when a Google token endpoint accepts the connection and never answers - Fixed the Claude apps gateway's start-up warning for a deprecated Claude Desktop key that it still serves as written saying "stops being accepted" after the key's end date - Fixed `/upgrade` opening the browser and starting a new login for plans billed through the App Store or Google Play; it now says where to change the plan - Fixed `--resume`, and rewinding past a switch to another model after a refusal, moving a session on a model name Claude Code doesn't recognize to a different model - Fixed requests failing when a gateway or cloud provider refuses one of Claude Code's beta headers by name: the request is sent again without it - Fixed model IDs spelled with a dot behind an LLM gateway, such as `claude-opus-4.8`, being treated as an older model with the wrong context window, output limit, effort, thinking mode and cost - Fixed Remote Control clients showing a stray "Compacted (ctrl+o to see full summary)" row after /compact - Fixed the cloud sessions tip and the Remote Control idle notice showing when an organization's policy turns those features off - Fixed a resumed claude.ai cloud session making a model call nobody asked for when the previous worker stopped just after receiving a new chat's files - Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions silently dropping a PDF's text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and where to read on - Fixed Claude being told only that a command was declined after you stopped it with Esc or Stop in a cloud session or the IDE; it now also hears that the command may have run - Fixed blank lines at the top of a code block disappearing when the code block opens a quote - Fixed a blank line appearing above some `⎿` rows in the transcript view (Ctrl+O) - Fixed vim mode `dw`, `dW`, `yw` and `yW` carrying on past the end of the line, and made `w` and `W` stop on empty lines - Fixed x and Enter in the agent panel sometimes acting on the wrong agent when another agent started or finished - Fixed pasted text and dragged-in files being lost in Claude's question dialog unless the "Other" row had focus - Fixed pasted text being lost when a row in the prompt footer was selected - Fixed vim mode `p` over a character selection ignoring whether the yanked text was whole lines - Fixed vim mode `aw` and `iw` taking the line break at the end of a line - Fixed ↓ selecting footer items hidden by the ? help menu, the command list or a paste hint - Fixed Esc on a command's panel, such as `/btw`, also interrupting the subagent whose transcript is open - Fixed the welcome header in fullscreen mode showing the session's model while viewing a subagent or teammate that runs on a different model - Fixed the fullscreen transcript being left mid-conversation after "Restore conversation" in the rewind menu while scrolled up - Fixed a rare case where a deleted session could reappear in the resume list as an almost empty entry - Fixed prompts containing tags such as `<bash-stdout>` or `<local-command-stdout>` not being acknowledged to a local stream-json host - Fixed sessions staying untitled when the first prompt failed (for example on a usage limit) and the conversation continued afterward - Fixed the skill file watcher checking every removed skill kept in `~/.claude/skills/.trash`, which added file system load that grew with each removal - Fixed the session name from /rename disappearing while Claude asks for permission or a plan decision, so side-by-side sessions stay identifiable - Fixed background sessions that fail to start being reported as a deleted daemon binary when the binary is still on disk - Fixed the tip and idle reminder about push notifications appearing when the push settings in `/config` are hidden or your organization has turned off Remote Control - Fixed `~/.claude/skills/.trash` and `~/.claude/plugins/.trash` growing without limit: each now holds about 1024 entries, whatever `cleanupPeriodDays` says - Fixed the Bash edit diff listing a whole file as changed when a CRLF file under git's line-ending conversion was re-saved unchanged or had one line edited - Self-hosted runner: Fixed an idle session moving to another runner instead of pausing when the runner's request to pause it lost its connection before Anthropic answered - Improved memory use in long headless and SDK turns that run many subagents: the parent session no longer keeps each subagent's tool results until the turn ends - Improved prompt history: Ctrl+R now matches text inside collapsed `[Pasted text]` pills - Improved the `/design-sync` upload prompt to show the folder, the project and the files it will upload or delete - Improved `/permissions` review tab, now called Recently blocked: the footer says what Esc will do with marked rows - Improved auto mode's blocked calls: messages name the command, say Claude may retry and auto mode checks again, and point to `/permissions` to review - Improved permission prompts: a long reason takes fewer rows, so it pushes the command being approved off the screen on fewer terminals - Improved the cloud session error shown while a request refused for your claude.ai login is still being retried: it now also suggests `claude auth login` - Improved the behavior of stored claude.ai, Team, and Enterprise logins when MDM and remote settings differ on base URL or `apiKeyHelper` - Improved `/config` in agent view to say how to stop agent view opening by default - Improved session auto-titles: a session that starts with a skill or a prompt-based command such as `/security-review` now gets a title from it instead of staying untitled - Improved `--resume` speed and memory use on damaged transcripts - Improved `/context` speed in sessions with ten thousand or more MCP tools - Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when a session's branch isn't on the git remote: it now covers a never-pushed branch, says how to fix each case, and no longer suggests retrying - Updated the `/claude-api` skill: its Datadog setup for API tracing now sends the `dd-llmobs-enabled: true` header, as the Console does, and its `ant` install instructions drop the outdated macOS `xattr` step - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to advise printing y-axis tick labels in full under 10,000, and horizontal ones in full under a million where they fit - Updated the bundled dataviz skill to answer donut and pie chart requests with ranked bars or a segmented bar that prints its values - Changed Claude's file tools to ask before editing the local copy of your organization's server-managed settings, as they do for your settings files - Changed `/ultrareview` to check workspace trust before it runs git, as `claude ultrareview` does - Changed the Bash tool's shell to clear any inherited `which` alias or function and to stop passing exported `which`/`unsetenv` functions to commands, so `which` is the system command or zsh builtin - Changed `/permissions` Recently blocked to refuse approving a call you can't read in full, including one the terminal is too short to show - Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a hook's allow of an MCP tool call now counts as no answer, so the classifier or a permission prompt decides - Changed hook `if` conditions such as `Monitor(tail *)` to match the Monitor tool's shell commands as `Bash(tail *)` matches Bash's - Changed the `claude-api` skill to ask to read a Managed Agents workflow run's workflow before changing the agent to improve that run - Changed flagged requests to retry on another model, not end in a refusal, when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `availableModels` or `deniedModels` leaves only an older Opus model, or none - Changed idle compaction to also run for subscribers with telemetry turned off, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and LLM gateways once the one-hour prompt cache is on - Changed `FORCE_HYPERLINK=false` (also `no` and `off`) to turn hyperlinks off instead of on - macOS: Changed `git grep` in most commands that Claude runs to use the C locale, to avoid a reported memory leak in macOS's regex library on files that aren't valid UTF-8 - [VSCode] Fixed "Clear authentication" for MCP servers reporting success when the saved sign-in could not be removed - [VSCode] Fixed missing spinner and Stop button while a queued message's hooks run - [VSCode] Fixed session group changes that cannot be saved, such as a delete, failing silently; an error notification now appears - [VSCode] Fixed Cmd+F / Ctrl+F not opening the find widget in the plan preview tab - [VSCode] Fixed the voice dictation shortcut (Ctrl+D) doing nothing under non-Latin keyboard layouts such as Russian, Greek or Hebrew - [VSCode] Fixed missed one-time saved scheduled tasks being deleted without asking when the extension opened without a chat - [VSCode] Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT` to also stop the extension adding the Claude in Chrome instructions to a session's messages; the browser tools stay available - [Cloud sessions] Added an Include completed button to the Scheduled tasks page when finished one-off tasks are the only ones hidden, so you can show them without opening the Sort menu - [Cloud sessions] Fixed recently used self-hosted environments never appearing among the recent environments on the new session card - [Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions reporting uncommitted changes every turn after Claude moved a branch to a commit it had pushed from another worktree - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings squeezing its content out of view in very short windows or at high zoom; the dialog now scrolls - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the permission mode picker staying on Auto after a running cloud or Remote Control session refused the switch; it now shows the mode in use and tells you - [Cloud sessions] Improved scheduled tasks: runs in Anthropic's cloud now load the plugins enabled on your claude.ai account - [Cloud sessions] Improved Test connection for GitHub Enterprise in admin settings to also connect the way cloud sessions do, and to warn you when that second test fails - [Cloud sessions] Improved cloud session transcripts: a rename row now names the new title, and repository and environment lists show as a table instead of one line of JSON - [Cloud sessions] Changed cloud sessions from the web, desktop and mobile apps to start even when a setup script exits with an error, instead of failing to start - [Remote Control] Fixed the permission mode button in Remote Control sessions showing the wrong mode until you typed; while your computer is online it now shows the real mode on open - [Claude Tag] Added a dismissible link to the Claude Tag API docs on the Bundles and Channels tabs in admin settings, for Enterprise organizations with Slack connected - [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` giving up after one failed workspace check in channels shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces; it now retries, then asks you to run it again - [Claude Tag] Fixed a second confirmation DM and channel note when you connect your Claude account from Slack twice from the same link within a few minutes - [Claude Tag] Fixed follow-up messages in Slack showing no sign of progress while Claude's session waits for a self-hosted runner; Claude now posts a wait notice in the thread - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes not answering a tag in its own thread in Slack Connect channels where both organizations have installed Claude - [Claude Tag] Fixed Retry on plugin and skill pages in Claude Tag admin settings discarding unsaved access changes after a failed load; your edits now stay in place - [Claude Tag] Fixed the repositories control in Claude Tag admin settings showing the same action twice; its menu now lists only what the button doesn't already do

Fixed `/effort` not warning about a prompt cache miss in plan mode when the plan model differs from the session model - Fixed `/ide` saying the VS Code extension was installed before the install finished or when it failed - Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried - Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running - Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results - Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted - Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds - Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file - Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions - Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab - Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session - Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held - Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error - Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work - Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load - Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error" - Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect - Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads - Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use - Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305) - Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0` - [VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls - [VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors - [VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE` - [VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes - [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does - [VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts - [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review

Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment" - Improved the lines shown when a mod written in the session loads, reloads or fails to load - Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views - Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins synced from claude.ai, unless a server sets `alwaysLoad: true` - Improved how a remote session recovers its status when the server refuses a status update that carried other session data - Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request - Improved the `claude -p` invalid-settings warning: a file that did not load lists only what stopped it, and long lists are capped per file - Improved resume of large compacted sessions in SDK and headless mode: the first request after resuming is sent sooner - Improved responsiveness and throughput when many subagents are running at the same time - Improved memory use when sending requests in long or resumed conversations - Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when the git host answers "not found" for a session's repository: it now names the repository and whom to ask - Windows: Improved git command start-up with a standard Git for Windows install by running its git.exe directly instead of through its cmd launcher - Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses - Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work - Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on - Changed tool search to be on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; a 400 or 422 from the gateway is retried without it - Changed compaction to send Claude the skill list again afterwards; `/reload-skills` now sends only new or changed skills - Changed skill hooks: the skills of one source (a repo, your own folder, or a plugin) can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters per session - Changed skills under a policy that allows hooks from plugins only: a skill used in the main conversation whose hooks are kept out no longer gets its `allowed-tools` - Updated the /claude-api skill to use the `ant` CLI on Claude Platform on AWS instead of falling back to the SDK or curl - Removed the notes from `claude plugin validate` that predicted where a mod's hooks would run - Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5 - [VSCode] Added mod drawing in the chat panel for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, behind an LLM gateway, or with telemetry turned off - [VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total - [VSCode] Fixed a session closed while it was starting keeping its Claude Code process running until the start ended - [VSCode] Fixed a mod's drawings disappearing from a long-open panel until the next turn on machines that also run an older Claude Code - [VSCode] Fixed Past conversations hiding sessions when `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` is set - [VSCode] Changed background sub-agents to show as one status line under their Agent card instead of streaming every step into the chat; the full transcript stays in /tasks - [Cloud sessions] Fixed folders in the composer's @ list showing no name in cloud sessions, where picking one added only a space instead of a mention - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread - [Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !fork` typed outside a thread getting no visible reply; Claude now shows you a private note saying to run it from inside a thread - [Code Review] Added review levels to Code Review: Owners choose Quick, Standard (the default), or Deep for the organization, and can give individual repositories their own level - [Code Review] Added an option in Code Review admin settings to review every repository in a GitHub organization, including ones added later, without selecting them one by one - [Code Review] Fixed pull requests opened within a minute or two of an admin turning on Code Review being silently skipped; they are now retried and reviewed

    - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode - Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off - Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026 - Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted - Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session - Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused - Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1` - Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction - Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind - Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format - Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet - Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available - Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away - Fixed `classifier_category` missing from OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events for most auto mode classifier blocks, and new `tool_decision` attributes pushing out `tool_use_id`, `tool_source` and `tool_parameters` when `OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT` is low - Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section - Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in - Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings - Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope` - Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits - Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks - Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin` - Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists - Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist - Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process - Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format - Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir` - Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows - Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied - Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in" - Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto - Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them - Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default - Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows - Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache - Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn - Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin - [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code - [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string - [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached - [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it - [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice - [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back - [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong" - [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected - [Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages - [Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands - [Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types - [Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack - [Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first - [Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page - [Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting - [Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install - [Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded - [Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded - [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels - [Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review setup not resuming after you leave to connect GitHub; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker

    - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting - Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI - Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y - Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line - Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules - Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` - Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits - Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model - Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files - Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed - Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority - Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call - Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in - Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders - Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8 - Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2 - Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock - Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh - Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user - Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first - Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested - Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine - Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL - Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text - Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card - Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS - Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind` - Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen - Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response - Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from - Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed - Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session - Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text - Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions - Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count - Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file - Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first - Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render - Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps - Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows - Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch` - Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made - [VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math - [VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels - [VSCode] Fixed a conversation that crashes or freezes the panel being reopened on every reload - [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down during long thinking: it no longer re-parses the whole thinking text on every update - [VSCode] Fixed diagnostics showing "[object Object]" instead of the rule code (e.g. MD013) for some language servers - [VSCode] Fixed the native dictation audio module being loaded, to check microphone permission, where dictation is not offered (non-claude.ai sign-ins, remote windows)

    - Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt - Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime - Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back - Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right - Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off - Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type` - Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before - Added the `prompt.change` mod hook, raised when the prompt box's text changes without a typed edit: a recalled history entry, a clear, an undo, or a plugin's fill - Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did - Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window - Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running - Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted` - Fixed `claude agents` not refreshing any pull request's status when the data for one of them came back incomplete - Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once - Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation - Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child - Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft - Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume - Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login` - Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories - Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does - Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short - Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`) - Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage - Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being recorded as typed in the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event and interaction span, and in session title requests - Fixed a note meant for Claude about mod hot-reloading appearing in the transcript as if you had typed it - Fixed agent hooks ignoring their `model`: aliases like `haiku` now resolve, a subagent's model no longer overrides it, and an unavailable model falls back to the caller's instead of allowing the action - Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's - Fixed the branch showing as ".invalid" and `--worktree` failing to reopen a worktree in repositories using git's reftable ref storage - Fixed Claude naming files in the session scratchpad by a bare filename or relative path instead of their full path - Fixed `claude remote-control` servers giving up on renewing their connection after a brief sign-in error, such as a locked keychain; they now retry, and warn when you need to run `claude /login` - Fixed `--worktree` failing in a worktree of a bare repository when origin's default branch can't be fetched; the fallback base is now the current checkout's HEAD, not the main repository's - Fixed starting Claude Code in a VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop integrated terminal launching the editor's command-line tool twice to check for the extension; it now launches it once - Fixed a mod's `prompt.edit` hook not being raised for a newline entered with the `chat:newline` keybinding (Ctrl+J, or a rebound Enter) - Fixed a conversation failing on every turn with a 400 error when the API rejected an MCP tool's input schema; Claude Code now sends that tool without parameters for the rest of the conversation - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on) - Fixed Claude not being told about an MCP server's tools and instructions until its next tool call, when the server finished connecting after a compaction - Fixed Remote Control sessions being marked stopped while still running, on a computer serving several sessions at once - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing its compaction summary or bringing back pre-compaction history, when the compaction followed a retried or unfinished reply in the same turn - Fixed Claude polling a background command's output file or sleeping while it runs - Fixed feature flags and staged rollouts staying stale behind a TLS-inspecting proxy whose certificate is trusted only through the OS certificate store - Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` printing "stopped" while a stuck background service kept running: it now waits, force-kills the service, and says so with exit 1 if it is still there - Fixed `claude daemon stop` exiting with no output, and leaving sessions listed as running, when telemetry is turned off - Fixed Write, Edit and NotebookEdit in Cowork cloud sessions reporting success for a path on your own computer, where the file never arrived - Fixed Claude searching for deferred tools already loaded earlier in the conversation when a session resumes a history that never listed them - Fixed secondary (dim) text looking the same as normal text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals - Fixed cloud sessions hanging 5 minutes per turn when the organization's policy can't be read; the turn now ends promptly and says why - Fixed a cloud session sometimes running an already answered message a second time after the session restarted during a long reply - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows) - Improved WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions to tell Claude that a page failed moments ago instead of fetching it again - Improved mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude scans a mod's files for keys before opening them, and asks before scanning a folder outside the project - Improved the note Claude 3 models get about an @-mentioned PDF, so they less often answer without reading it - Improved artifact updates: Claude now applies a small change and republishes the artifact in one call, and makes larger edits and republishes within a single response - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` sessions to ignore CA-bundle, tool-proxy, git TLS and git config variables like `SSL_CERT_FILE` in settings; under Claude Desktop, only in project settings - Changed exit to force-kill background commands still running 1.5 seconds after being asked to stop; in fullscreen mode they could previously be left running - Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start - Changed `claude gateway` to stop at start, naming the key, on a `desktop:` policy key that Claude Desktop cannot use from a gateway, where it earlier started with a warning - Changed large requests to api.anthropic.com to use gzip compression even when telemetry is disabled; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` to turn it off - Changed the `claude-api` skill to leave Managed Agents sessions in place unless you ask to archive or delete them - Changed background sessions to resume a carried workflow through the Workflow tool's approval instead of running it from the handoff file - Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt, tools and parameters, so a transcript you choose to share can reproduce a request exactly - Changed the `/sandbox` mode options to read "Sandbox commands" instead of "Sandbox BashTool" - Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks in Cowork cloud sessions: a `setMode` update in a hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies - Changed hooks: `updatedInput` from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks is now validated like Claude's own input: unknown keys are dropped, and input the tool rejects denies the call - Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions - [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting to stop text selected in the editor from being added to your messages - [VSCode] Fixed fast mode staying on after usage credits ran out, which made each request be refused and re-sent; it now turns off until you turn it back on, with an error notice - [VSCode] Fixed the Thinking toggle switching to Off on models that always think; the toggle is no longer shown for those models - [VSCode] Fixed "Edit prompt" on a flagged message opening the file or command menu over the restored prompt; Enter now sends it as written - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file onto the prompt on Windows inserting an unreadable `/c:/…` path instead of a mention relative to the working directory - [VSCode] Fixed changes to VS Code's chat font size settings needing a window reload or being undone by a theme change; diffs and the plan preview now follow them too - [VSCode] Fixed "Resume session" and tabs restored after a reload opening an empty new conversation instead of one that had moved into a git worktree - [VSCode] Fixed ↑ then Enter on a recalled slash command running it without its arguments; the command and file menus no longer open over a recalled prompt until you edit it - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file from the Explorer or an editor tab onto the prompt inserting nothing in WSL, SSH and Dev Container windows - [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Alt+F toggling Focus view instead of opening Find in the Explorer, other tree views, or the Debug Console on Windows and Linux - [VSCode] Fixed the check for sessions open in other windows or terminals creating extra processes on macOS: it now starts `/bin/ps` directly instead of searching PATH for `ps` on every check - [VSCode] Windows: Fixed a conversation showing "still open somewhere else" after a crash or power loss, when Windows had since restarted and given the old process ID to another program - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Allow for this task" missing from Cowork's approval prompts for connector tools where an organization turns off "Always allow" (regression in 2.1.292) - [Cloud sessions] Fixed most commands in the / menu losing their descriptions in cloud sessions once you sent a second message - [Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified;     - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents - Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight` - Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish - Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives - Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; Fixed sign-in, MCP servers and project trust appearing lost on Linux after a sandboxed command left an empty `.config.json` in the config directory - Fixed `/sandbox` reporting success when its setting could not be saved because the project folder is not writable; it now says nothing changed and why - Fixed a settings file being ignored when `enabledMcpjsonServers` or `disabledMcpjsonServers` held a single server name (letters, digits, - or _) as a plain string - Fixed `claude plugin test` pausing a hook's time budget while a served `$` method it had called kept making `$` calls after answering - Fixed the image coordinate hint being missing or slightly off for large near-square images on newer models - Fixed feature flag, startup, fast mode, profile and feedback requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); Anthropic API keys are still sent - Fixed MCP connections over HTTP hanging for 30 seconds and failing when a server never ends the body of its reply to a notification (anthropics/claude-code#99014) - Fixed MCP servers added to a running headless or SDK session being connected before some policy checks ran; a blocked server is now reported as failed without being contacted - Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in, token refresh and sign-out not sending configured `headers`/`headersHelper` values, which broke servers behind an authenticating proxy - Fixed the Artifact tool reporting a spurious one-line difference against the live page, and refusing the publish, when a large page with a line break after `<head>` is published again unchanged - Fixed `$.ui.open` reporting a mod's pane as placed in sessions where no surface draws it, such as Claude Code for VS Code and `claude -p` - Fixed the `agent.spawn` mod hook not running when a finished subagent or a killed teammate is resumed: the hook's event now carries `resume`, and a mod can refuse it - Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting a mod's `$.state` references when `plugin.json` has no `types` key and the contract is at `./types/index.d.ts` - Fixed a mod's `dimColor` text looking the same as plain text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals -
