Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` not excluding a symlinked `.claude/rules` file when the pattern names the rules directory or the symlink rather than its target - Fixed runaway session-title syncing to Remote Control when two Claude Code processes shared one background job's state (2.1.232 regression); title updates are now deduplicated and rate-limited - Fixed sessions whose title starts with `/` being unaddressable by `SendMessage` and shown as "(untitled)" in `ListAgents` - Fixed Ctrl+W, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+K, Option+Backspace, Option+D and vim `df`/`dt` leaving a broken `[Pasted text #N]` placeholder when the cursor was inside it - Fixed masked (password-style) inputs such as the login code field letting their text be pasted back with Ctrl+Y elsewhere or saved to prompt history when cleared with double Esc - Fixed Ctrl+Backspace deleting one character instead of a word in search boxes - Fixed a request rejected by an organization policy check being re-sent before the rejection was shown - Improved the reminder shown after compaction so a skill's original arguments are not re-run as a new request - Long file paths on tool-use rows now truncate in the middle to stay on one line - Remote sessions keep sending keep-alives while a long `SessionStart` or `Setup` hook runs, so the container is not idle-reaped mid-hook - `/goal`: repeat check-ins on long-running background work now back off (30 min, then 1 h, then every 2 h) instead of repeating every 30 minutes - `/goal`: resuming a session from the `claude --resume` picker now restores its active goal - `ListAgents` now tells a session its own name (the one peers use to message it), and `SendMessage` to your own name says so instead of "no agent named …" - `ListAgents` and `/list-agents` now list your live teammates (previously only subagents and other sessions appeared, so a reachable teammate looked absent) - `keybindingFlavor: "readline"` now also matches Bash for word keys: Alt+F and Ctrl/Option+→ stop at the end of the word, Alt+D deletes to it (Ctrl+Y pastes it back), and punctuation separates words - Persistent retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) now fails immediately on organization spend-limit and out-of-credits errors instead of waiting indefinitely for a reset - Claude in Chrome: `/clear` now closes the session's Chrome tab group, and empty groups are closed on `/resume` and when Claude Code exits - Remote sessions: images uploaded from mobile now include their saved file path, so Claude can copy them into files it creates - Claude Code on the web: requests from Bash and other tools to non-API anthropic.com hosts (e.g. www, docs) now go through the session's network proxy, so your environment's allowed domains apply - Remote Control: clearer message and `claude doctor` wording when Remote Control isn't enabled for your account - Windows: cross-session messaging is now available, so Claude Code sessions across your machines can message each other with `SendMessage` and find each other with `ListAgents`, as on macOS and Linux - [VSCode] "View usage" in the usage-limit banner now sits inline with the warning text instead of floating mid-banner

Fixed the workflow save dialog showing `~/.claude/workflows/` instead of the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` location for user-scope saves - Fixed `/release-notes` adding the viewed notes to the model's context — "Show all" previously injected the entire changelog into every subsequent request - Fixed a memory leak in the agent view where pasted images were retained for the screen's lifetime after sending peek replies - Fixed SDK sessions losing agents defined via the initialize request when a plugin refresh ran before the client attached - Fixed several memory leaks in long sessions: MCP stdio server stderr accumulating up to 64 MB per server, LSP documents staying open indefinitely (now LRU with 50-doc cap), async hook output retained after backgrounding, and unbounded growth in headless/SDK sessions from large tool-result payloads - Fixed a memory blowup when reading files with extremely long single lines using offset/limit — the read now returns a clean error instead of loading the whole line - Fixed multi-second per-turn slowdowns in sessions with many permission deny/ask rules — rule matchers are now compiled once and cached - Improved input responsiveness while agent task lists update — task updates no longer re-render the entire UI - Reduced per-tool-call CPU overhead in print/SDK sessions with many MCP tools by caching tool-pool assembly (up to 7x faster tool rounds at high tool counts) - Reduced memory usage by bounding the file edit read cache to 16 MB instead of pinning up to 1,000 full files - Reduced session transcript size (up to 79x in edit-heavy sessions) and bounded checkpoint disk usage by pruning superseded file-history backups - Reduced memory usage when resuming sessions with background agents or forks spawned from large conversations - Completed background agents now stay listed in `/tasks` until cleanup instead of vanishing the moment they finish - Attaching to a stopped background agent now shows its transcript immediately while the session warms up, instead of a blank "Session is starting" screen - Background sessions: an older daemon no longer silently restarts workers spawned by a newer version onto the older binary - Agent view: Ctrl+X now deletes renamed-branch worktrees, never destroys unpushed commits, keeps the session row when a worktree is kept, and reused worktree names reset to the current base - Catastrophic removals (e.g. `rm -rf ~`) in commands containing `$(…)`/backticks/`<(…)` now prompt in `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and auto mode, matching the plain form - `/install-github-app` and the `/mcp` settings menu no longer open in background sessions - MCP servers configured with an empty URL now show as "not configured" in `/mcp` instead of a config error - `/usage` now shows your last-known usage bars with an "as of" note when the usage endpoint is rate-limited, instead of an error screen - Fixed Bedrock auth failing with "Session token not found or invalid" for AWS SSO profiles whose sso_region differs from the Bedrock region (2.1.207 regression)

Fixed zsh heredoc failing with "read-only file system" error in sandboxed commands (anthropics/claude-code#25990) - Fixed agent progress indicator showing inflated tool use count (anthropics/claude-code#26023) - Fixed image pasting not working on WSL2 systems where Windows copies images as BMP format (anthropics/claude-code#25935) - Fixed background agent results returning raw transcript data instead of the agent's final answer (anthropics/claude-code#26012) - Fixed Warp terminal incorrectly prompting for Shift+Enter setup when it supports it natively (anthropics/claude-code#25957) - Fixed CJK wide characters causing misaligned timestamps and layout elements in the TUI (anthropics/claude-code#26084) - Fixed custom agent `model` field in `.claude/agents/*.md` being ignored when spawning team teammates (anthropics/claude-code#26064) - Fixed plan mode being lost after context compaction, causing the model to switch from planning to implementation mode (anthropics/claude-code#26061) - Fixed `alwaysThinkingEnabled: true` in settings.json not enabling thinking mode on Bedrock and Vertex providers (anthropics/claude-code#26074) - Fixed `tool_decision` OTel telemetry event not being emitted in headless/SDK mode (anthropics/claude-code#26059) - Fixed session name being lost after context compaction — renamed sessions now preserve their custom title through compaction (anthropics/claude-code#26121) - Increased initial session count in resume picker from 10 to 50 for faster session discovery (anthropics/claude-code#26123) - Windows: fixed worktree session matching when drive letter casing differs (anthropics/claude-code#26123) - Fixed `/resume <session-id>` failing to find sessions whose first message exceeds 16KB (anthropics/claude-code#25920) - Fixed "Always allow" on multiline bash commands creating invalid permission patterns that corrupt settings (anthropics/claude-code#25909) - Fixed React crash (error #31) when a skill's `argument-hint` in SKILL.md frontmatter uses YAML sequence syntax (e.g., `[topic: foo | bar]`) — the value is now properly coerced to a string (anthropics/claude-code#25826) - Fixed crash when using `/fork` on sessions that used web search — null entries in search results from transcript deserialization are now handled gracefully (anthropics/claude-code#25811) - Fixed read-only git commands triggering FSEvents file watcher loops on macOS by adding --no-optional-locks flag (anthropics/claude-code#25750) - Fixed custom agents and skills not being discovered when running from a git worktree — project-level `.claude/agents/` and `.claude/skills/` from the main repository are now included (anthropics/claude-code#25816) - Fixed non-interactive subcommands like `claude doctor` and `claude plugin validate` being blocked inside nested Claude sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25803) - Windows: Fixed the same CLAUDE.md file being loaded twice when drive letter casing differs between paths (anthropics/claude-code#25756) - Fixed inline code spans in markdown being incorrectly parsed as bash commands (anthropics/claude-code#25792) - Fixed teammate spinners not respecting custom spinnerVerbs from settings (anthropics/claude-code#25748) - Fixed shell commands permanently failing after a command deletes its own working directory (anthropics/claude-code#26136) - Fixed hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse) silently failing to execute on Windows by using Git Bash instead of cmd.exe (anthropics/claude-code#25981) - Fixed LSP `findReferences` and other location-based operations returning results from gitignored files (e.g., `node_modules/`, `venv/`) (anthropics/claude-code#26051) - Moved config backup files from home directory root to `~/.claude/backups/` to reduce home directory clutter (anthropics/claude-code#26130) - Fixed sessions with large first prompts (>16KB) disappearing from the /resume list (anthropics/claude-code#26140) - Fixed shell functions with double-underscore prefixes (e.g., `__git_ps1`) not being preserved across shell sessions (anthropics/claude-code#25824) - Fixed spinner showing "0 tokens" counter before any tokens have been received (anthropics/claude-code#26105) - VSCode: Fixed conversation messages appearing dimmed while the AskUserQuestion dialog is open (anthropics/claude-code#26078) - Fixed background tasks failing in git worktrees due to remote URL resolution reading from worktree-specific gitdir instead of the main repository config (anthropics/claude-code#26065) - Fixed Right Alt key leaving visible `[25~` escape sequence residue in the input field on Windows/Git Bash terminals (anthropics/claude-code#25943) - The `/rename` command now updates the terminal tab title by default (anthropics/claude-code#25789) - Fixed Edit tool silently corrupting Unicode curly quotes (\u201c\u201d \u2018\u2019) by replacing them with straight quotes when making edits (anthropics/claude-code#26141) - Fixed OSC 8 hyperlinks only being clickable on the first line when link text wraps across multiple terminal lines.

Codex CLI

Latest: v0.169.0
  • v0.169.0 2026-11-13
    ▼
    ## New Features - The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181) - Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286) - Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557) - Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662) - Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542) - With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651) ## Bug Fixes - `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041) - **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763) - Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647) - Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455) - The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622) - Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700) ## Documentation - Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949) - Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819) ## Chores - Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432) - Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads.   • v0.168.0 2026-11-13
    ▼
    ## New Features - Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats. (#59541, #59722) - Enable `features.tui_workspace` to view a side conversation beside the main chat. Drag the divider to resize the panes or press `leader z` to zoom the focused pane. (#58992, #59527, #59595) - Attach recordings when using an audio-capable model. Codex skips confirmed rejected recordings on later turns and uses clip duration to keep more short recordings in context. (#59234, #59268) - Enable `features.image_generation_animation` to generate or edit animated GIFs with optional frame count and timing controls. (#59073) - Fullscreen Codex displays image previews and pets in tmux on Ghostty and Kitty with `allow-passthrough all`. (#59579, #59580) - Set `tui.notification_method = "osc777"` for terminal notifications. Approval notifications show longer command previews and distinguish terminal input from network access requests. (#59256) ## Bug Fixes - Local TUI history and resume pickers filter newly created threads by the signed-in ChatGPT account. (#58918) - Open and resumed chats use their saved model provider after you change the default for new chats. (#59503) - The TUI renders replies interrupted by tool calls as a single Markdown message and restores reasoning summaries when replaying a conversation. (#59698, #59700) - Steering messages reach running turns when sent during the final transcript save or after switching back to a long-running chat. (#58877, #58998) - Fuzzy file search gives filename matches more weight so matching parent directories are less likely to crowd them out. (#59709) - Idle local MCP servers on Windows leave filesystem I/O available to the rest of Codex. (#59726) ## Documentation - The app-server reference covers listing model providers, creating custom gateways, and updating gateway, Bedrock, and GCP settings. (#58845, #58876) ## Chores - Codex warns when `features.multi_agent` is explicitly configured and points to `agents.enabled` for disabling subagent tools. (#59479) - Contributors can run Bazel CI jobs locally without BuildBuddy credentials.   • v0.167.0 2026-11-06
    ▼
    ## New Features - Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264). - Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457). - Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446). - Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427). - Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157). - Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281). ## Bug Fixes - Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202). - `Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266). - Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412). - Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351). - Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221). - Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404). ## Documentation - The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182). - The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134). ## Chores - DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757). - Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399). ## Changelog Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.166.0...rust-v0.167.0 -     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Added chips above the Web Shell composer for unfinished background workflows, shells, monitors, and local agents, replacing the status-bar task pill. ([#16813](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16813)) by @qqqys - Added Chinese localization for GitHub channel event prompts in PR-bound sessions when the channel UI language is Chinese, while other languages remain English. ([#16773](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16773)) by @wenshao - Managed MCP now counts only up to 32 live selections, retains removed entries for recovery, keeps the 16-enabled limit, and caps retained snapshots at 96 entries. ([#15161](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15161)) by @yiliang114 - Added managed-agent SPIs that let embedding applications import exact Skill or extension revisions from external sources and store compiled archives in private storage. ([#16882](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16882)) by @doudouOUC - Enables Mods to rewrite displayed reply rows in the OpenTUI terminal via ui.render while preserving stored message text and /copy output. ([#16873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16873)) by @qqqys - Records pull request states from slim listings and passes their keys to the watch so closed pull requests can leave view rotation correctly. ([#16847](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16847)) by @wenshao - Adds a sending-only dingtalk-webhook channel that posts notifications and successful task results as Markdown to configured DingTalk custom group robots. ([#16802](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16802)) by @jkxiao - Sidebar session lists now expand ten sessions per click, with labels showing remaining count, instead of showing all at once. ([#16830](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16830)) by @wenshao - Managed Sessions now store oversized resources and compacted closed journals in object storage, preserving recovery and normal reads. ([#16868](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16868)) by @doudouOUC - Adds internal event-bus primitives for the unified agent loop without changing current behavior. ([#16935](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16935)) by @wenshao - Adds DingTalk webhook configuration in Web Shell and lets Scheduled Tasks pick saved Channel destinations. ([#16804](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16804)) by @jkxiao - Lets embedding hosts add header and per-model content to the composer model picker while preserving native search, selection, and keyboard behavior. ([#16933](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16933)) by @callmeYe - Adds opt-in AgentLoopOptions.useEventBus to run the shared agent loop on event-bus handlers without changing observable behavior. ([#16938](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16938)) by @wenshao - The sandboxed /verify flow now deepens the checkout to include the PR and base history needed before verification, improving handling of force-pushes and missing commits. ([#16781](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16781)) by @wenshao - feat(cli): enable the event-bus agent loop on headless behind an experimental setting ([#16994](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16994)) by @wenshao - When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, AgentCore model rounds now run through the shared agent loop. ([#16880](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16880)) by @qqqys - feat(workflows): allow model-requested background runs in ACP sessions ([#16876](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16876)) by @qqqys - feat(core): run AgentCore's tool batches on the shared agent loop ([#17035](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17035)) by @qqqys - feat: Manual session PR binding (/pr command + Web Shell dialog) ([#16877](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16877)) by @wenshao - Managed agent journal readers now resolve evicted records from journal packs, enabling qwen.managed-agent.session-resources.deletion-enabled. ([#17047](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17047)) by @doudouOUC - Managed Sessions now store self-paced /loop wakeups durably in the session journal so they survive restarts and takeovers. ([#16835](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16835)) by @wenshao ### Bug Fixes - Fixed managed-agent session close to release the MCP owner so MCP configurations are no longer left drained or held after closing. ([#16728](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16728)) by @wenshao - Improved managed-agent reliability when parsing Harness conflict error codes, reading host command output, and reporting exception causes. ([#16826](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16826)) by @doudouOUC - Web Shell approval picker is now more compact, and Full Access (yolo) is visually marked as a destructive, high-risk mode. ([#16874](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16874)) by @callmeYe - CI ephemeral runners can now remain available past their age threshold and finish late-assigned jobs instead of being destroyed prematurely. ([#16871](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16871)) by @yiliang114 - Web Shell WeChat login startup now uses the daemon's longer QR creation timeout, preventing logins from aborting when QR minting takes up to 30 seconds. ([#16838](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16838)) by @wenshao - CLI startup in Docker or Podman sandboxes now creates the sandbox home directory and tolerates a missing $HOME instead of crashing. ([#16878](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16878)) by @yiliang114 - Web Shell managed model changes are now acknowledged correctly after failed reads, preventing the picker from staying stuck and avoiding duplicate resubmissions. ([#16869](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16869)) by @yiliang114 - Fixed CI failures by making TUI agent-loop parity approval waits verify approved file effects and restoring checkstyle import order, improving pipeline reliability. ([#16881](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16881)) by @wenshao - Fixed CI capture tests on fork PR runners by installing the DejaVu font package so bold and plain terminal renders differ correctly. ([#16864](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16864)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Allows ephemeral runner managers to drain running jobs before shutdown, reducing interrupted jobs and leftover containers during restarts. ([#16892](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16892)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes the shell-command explanation and thinking-translation popovers to keep their intended 480px width instead of falling back to a narrower default. ([#16916](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16916)) by @callmeYe - Fixes private CSI retirements that stalled after freezing by reading frozen commit bodies with the correct larger size limit. ([#16923](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16923)) by @doudouOUC - Allows manual workspace memory forget while automatic memory is disabled, and Direct ACP rejects it when an external tool guard provider is attached. ([#16913](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16913)) by @callmeYe - Aligns shell-command approval explanation and permission choices in one responsive footer so the approval card looks consistent on wide and narrow screens. ([#16914](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16914)) by @callmeYe - Moves sidebar session sorting next to multi-select in the session action row, keeping sort options and saved preferences unchanged. ([#16776](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16776)) by @deggs7 - Raises the web-shell production build heap limit to 4096MB to prevent macOS out-of-memory failures during companion releases. ([#16902](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16902)) by @yiliang114 - GitHub channel now retries stored replies in the background while running after rate-limit refusals, not only at start. ([#16839](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16839)) by @wenshao - CLI channel status now counts routes persisted by qwen serve workers, fixing underreported daemon-managed channel conversations. ([#16929](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16929)) by @wenshao - Fixes base64 handling so activation proof fields honor their declared size limits instead of being incorrectly clamped. ([#16934](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16934)) by @doudouOUC - Managed model selection follows DAC flow and applies immediately after validation, refreshing in background without blocking confirmation. ([#16890](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16890)) by @yiliang114 - CI pool jobs now clear stale package-manager cache and workspace git state before checkout, preventing failures from previous runs. ([#16939](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16939)) by @yiliang114 - In auto-edit mode, tool calls matching permissions.ask rules now require confirmation instead of being automatically approved. ([#16932](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16932)) by @qqqys - Web Shell now supports GitLab as a repository-only channel, accepting nested project paths and hiding direct-message controls. ([#16845](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16845)) by @wenshao - fix(managed-agent): map the resend identity conflict to 409 and pin the projection wire shape ([#16846](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16846)) by @wenshao - Centralized CSI retirement size bounds and strengthened base64 validation so managed-agent retirement commits stay within consistent limits. ([#16956](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16956)) by @doudouOUC - Updated the CI workflow-size baseline after approved growth so nightly release script tests stop failing. ([#16978](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16978)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Added a builder lease to prevent concurrent journal-pack publication races that could advance watermarks without publishing a pack. ([#16983](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16983)) by @doudouOUC - Vertically centers the live-session timeline in the chat area and keeps turn navigation aligned when request confirmation is visible. ([#16912](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16912)) by @callmeYe - Cancels pending QQ login sessions when the channel editor closes or the page unloads, preventing stale login sessions from lingering. ([#16841](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16841)) by @wenshao - Makes file-history backup capture crash-safe by writing backups atomically, preserving permissions, and cleaning up temporary files on failure. ([#16926](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16926)) by @wenshao - Fixed CLI detach so config-scoped Hook owners are not prematurely released, preventing recovered turns from invalidating owners that should persist. ([#16594](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16594)) by @wenshao - System prompts are now resolved after selecting the model for each request, improving correctness for overrides, fallbacks, and non-streaming requests. ([#17023](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17023)) by @callmeYe - Fixed the CLI SSH storage probe to reject hosts with unreadable machine identities using a clear non-retryable error instead of leaking ENOENT. ([#17034](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17034)) by @yiliang114 - Fixed web-shell home-only embeddings to hide redundant navigation while keeping settings, theme, status, and expand controls in the session footer. ([#17027](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17027)) by @chiga0 - Updated Browser Use to bundle Zod 4.6.6, removing an advisory-affected dependency; locator validation stays the same, while error code and message text may change. ([#17022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17022)) by @yiliang114 - Fixed Settings in the web-shell welcome screen so the selected model immediately shows as current after Set current is clicked. ([#16819](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16819)) by @deggs7 - Changed permission handling so commands containing git commit --amend require human approval instead of being hard blocked in AUTO mode. ([#16075](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16075)) by @yiliang114 - ci: classify the disk floor refusal, and keep survey checkouts off /tmp ([#17011](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17011)) by @yiliang114 - fix(managed-agent): repair rename recovery test and address the #17006 review round ([#17043](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17043)) by @doudouOUC - fix(permissions): see the write in a `>|` clobber redirect ([#17042](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17042)) by @yiliang114 ### Performance - Managed Agent reconciliation skips unnecessary delivery-record reads and batches segment-plan writes and reads, reducing sweep overhead. ([#16865](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16865)) by @wenshao ### Documentation - docs(providers): document Wiro AI under OpenAI-compatible providers ([#16850](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16850)) by @EminBudak - Clarified documentation that the Skill endpoint updates workspace Skill settings by name. ([#16833](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16833)) by @521Peter - README now includes a Qwen Code 1.0 Preview section with links and clarifies that installation commands shown below are for the main version. ([#16872](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16872)) by @0xvincent - Formatted README with the repository's pinned Prettier version to fix the Lint & Static workflow failure without changing prose or code. ([#16887](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16887)) by @yiliang114 - Updated WeChat channel documentation to name the conversation the bot reads and explain admission steps that can silently drop messages. ([#16888](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16888)) by @wenshao - Updates reply-loss design notes to match terminal-drain behavior, clarifying release-before-forward ends with the session released and no storage owner retained. ([#16898](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16898)) by @yiliang114 - Clarifies WeChat documentation that unapproved first messages receive a pairing-code reply and are not replayed after approval. ([#16930](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16930)) by @wenshao - Documentation now lists only the current deletion-enabled reader-migration preconditions and notes that WorkspaceCsiCheckpointSnapshotStore was removed. ([#16984](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16984)) by @doudouOUC - Managed Agent gate documentation now explains why the gate is not yet a required check and how its pass rate is measured. ([#16955](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16955)) by @yiliang114 - Design docs now cross-link the event-bus agent loop and unified-agent loop and update the unified-loop status. ([#17014](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17014)) by @wenshao - Updated Browser Use development documentation to use corepack pnpm install instead of npm install. ([#17019](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17019)) by @qqqys - CLAUDE.md now imports AGENTS.md so repository conventions load automatically at session start. ([#17017](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17017)) by @qqqys - Updated Browser Use documentation to correctly attribute bundle-size differences to esbuild path comments. ([#17041](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17041)) by @yiliang114 - docs(core): correct stale PR status and preview file count in event-bus design ([#16952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16952)) by @wenshao ### Internal Changes - Made hosted tool output publication always asynchronous, returning HTTP 202 pending state and relying on background verification instead of synchronous upload mode. ([#16840](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16840)) by @doudouOUC - Added CLI tests verifying OpenTUI steering input and retry behavior when experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled. ([#16820](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16820)) by @qqqys - Improves test fidelity for managed-agent channel recording without changing production behavior. ([#16843](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16843)) by @wenshao - Improved CI reliability by giving the hosted-harness message-stop test a longer settle budget for the halted message turn, reducing flaky failures. ([#16855](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16855)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Fixed web-shell browser tests by making Collapse button lookups exact so they no longer match Collapse all workspaces. ([#16905](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16905)) by @yiliang114 - Restored the nightly Desktop Checks RHEL 10 rpm build by re-pinning the build root to a current CentOS Stream 10 image digest. ([#16897](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16897)) by @yiliang114 - Updates subscription activation tests to match the current behavior where activated models are not persisted as workspace default. ([#16904](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16904)) by @yiliang114 - Improves web-shell test stability by starting the composer context mobile hover check from a neutral focus state. ([#16907](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16907)) by @yiliang114 - Improves managed-agent CSI retirement reliability by limiting retirement evidence to the affected session. ([#16910](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16910)) by @doudouOUC - Adds acceptance tests for generated UI bill splitter, checklist, activity form, and plan comparator scenarios. ([#16811](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16811)) by @qqqys - Fixes the nightly web-shell Browser Regression test cluster by addressing E2E-layer failures without changing product behavior. ([#16919](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16919)) by @yiliang114 - Completes managed-agent broker facade decomposition with no user-visible behavior change. ([#16922](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16922)) by @doudouOUC - Removes uncalled managed-agent CSI admission and workspace catalog code with no user-visible behavior change. ([#16928](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16928)) by @doudouOUC - Refactors managed-agent persistence by extracting binding admission and fence engine logic without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16936](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16936)) by @doudouOUC - Adds CI tests that pin lint-lane gate conditions and failure policy for docs-only pull requests without changing workflow behavior. ([#16950](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16950)) by @yiliang114 - Preinstalled Chromium, ffmpeg, and libraries in the disposable-runner CI image and capped typecheck heap to avoid browser downloads. ([#16951](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16951)) by @yiliang114 - Made TUI agent-loop parity tests ignore the startup date so runs crossing midnight no longer fail. ([#16961](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16961)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Removed unused CSI checkpoint snapshot and pod-log reader tooling that had no production callers. ([#16957](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16957)) by @doudouOUC - Finished CSI bound cleanup so managed-agent history decoding consistently enforces the new size limits. ([#16981](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16981)) by @doudouOUC - Routed credential-free Web Shell PR jobs to ephemeral runners while keeping privileged publishing and managed-host push runs on GitHub-hosted runners. ([#16917](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16917)) by @yiliang114 - Removes unused in-memory runtime broker repositories and shifts tests to JDBC storage to match production behavior. ([#16953](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16953)) by @doudouOUC - Re-runs a failed unit-test workspace once when Vitest reports only worker RPC timeout errors, reducing false CI failures on contended hosts. ([#16945](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16945)) by @yiliang114 - CI now checks host CPU load before unit suites start and fails quickly with a rerun prompt when the host is too contended. ([#16987](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16987)) by @yiliang114 - Added tests ensuring the default tool executor correctly passes scheduler options and runtime content-generator view through the event-bus path. ([#17009](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17009)) by @wenshao - Session renames now complete synchronously, so the confirmed session title is shown immediately and consistently. ([#17006](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17006)) by @doudouOUC - CI lint gate freshness checks are narrowed to the lint slice and related follow-up fixes are included. ([#16946](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16946)) by @yiliang114 - SSH bootstrap process tests now pin the Linux host machine-id to avoid failures on runners lacking it. ([#16976](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16976)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Hardened the lint freshness gate so stale lint configurations and invalid workflow definitions cause a clear CI failure. ([#17028](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17028)) by @yiliang114 - test(channels): pin bound-event localization contracts ([#17026](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17026)) by @wenshao - ci: bake the standalone runtime archives into the ephemeral image ([#17033](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17033)) by @yiliang114 - chore(managed-agent): trim verification meta-ratchets and align local gate profiles ([#17044](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17044)) by @doudouOUC - Internal test now opens Settings from the inline footer action in Home-only shells instead of the removed More menu. ([#17066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17066)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Container-boundary preflight tests now derive expected isolation markers from the environment while still requiring SANDBOX=docker. ([#17049](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17049)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Managed agent server distribution now ships as a single executable jar, removing redundant operator-tool jars.   • v0.27.2 2026-11-10
    ▼
    <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights - Web Shell can configure WeChat, QQ, and Email channels, including QR login, scan progress, identity display, and logout where supported. ([#16736](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16736), [#16724](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16724), [#16746](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16746)) - Mods can run one-off $.model.complete calls, rewrite displayed AssistantMessage text via ui.render, and persist plugin values with $.store. ([#16737](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16737), [#16794](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16794), [#16791](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16791)) - /btw side questions are replayed for context, and Managed Agent adds private follow-ups with manual or optional automatic session recaps. ([#16408](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16408), [#16758](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16758)) - Pending approvals now appear in the live panel and can trigger a terminal bell or desktop notification when the terminal is unfocused. ([#16800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16800), [#16809](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16809)) - Web Shell shows turns, output speed, total tokens, and cache hit rate under the composer, with hover details and Token Usage access. ([#16815](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16815)) - Users can import a Skill from the original Runtime workspace of a selected Session and install it explicitly without re-uploading it. ([#16638](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16638)) ## Breaking Changes - fix(deps)!: upgrade dependencies shipped by SDK and Web Shell ([#16452](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16452)) by @yiliang114 ## Complete Change List ### Features - Lets users import a Skill from the original Runtime workspace of a selected Session and install it explicitly without re-uploading it. ([#16638](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16638)) by @doudouOUC - Makes /btw side questions part of the session and replays the last 20 answered side questions so follow-ups can reference earlier ones. ([#16408](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16408)) by @sorrycc - Adds Tool v4 execution measurements to Managed activity diagnostics, showing duration, valid sample counts, and proposed versus applied line changes. ([#16498](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16498)) by @doudouOUC - Daemon PR-state watch adds allowed-host discovery from gh configuration and ordered shutdown while remaining turned off. ([#16732](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16732)) by @wenshao - With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, OpenTUI model rounds now run through the shared agent loop, improving parity with Ink while keeping its own tool step. ([#16743](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16743)) by @qqqys - Mods can now run one-off text completions with $.model.complete(request, {signal}), using the session client without tools, history, or an added system prompt. ([#16737](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16737)) by @qqqys - Managed Agent adds private BTW follow-ups and manual or optional automatic session recap, with WebShell panels using persisted results; automatic recap is off by default. ([#16758](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16758)) by @doudouOUC - Goal verifier verdicts now show the Last check reason in the session output language while decision values remain accept or reject. ([#15806](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15806)) by @4ekuct25 - Mods can now use the AssistantMessage render site and ui.render hook to rewrite displayed model reply text in the Ink terminal without changing stored or copied text. ([#16794](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16794)) by @qqqys - Self-hosted autofix runs now have a 240-minute agent budget, reducing premature timeouts for long autofix rounds. ([#16777](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16777)) by @wenshao - feat(web-shell): configure the Email channel from the channel manager ([#16746](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16746)) by @wenshao - feat(cli): run OpenTUI's tool batches on the shared agent loop ([#16789](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16789)) by @qqqys - feat(mods): keep each plugin's values between sessions with $.store ([#16791](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16791)) by @qqqys - Web shell managed sessions can reuse host shell chrome with showManagedSessionHeader and alignManagedChatWithHost, reducing duplicate headers and hints. ([#16324](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16324)) by @yiliang114 - Managed Agent channel delivery ledger now records each delivery segment separately, preserving segment receipts for multi-segment deliveries. ([#16797](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16797)) by @wenshao - Adds requireBoundWatch to the GitHub channel so review or verify bindings receive PR events only while an active /autofix-pr or /verify-pr watch is held. ([#16772](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16772)) by @wenshao - Adds WeChat as a configurable Web Shell channel with in-browser QR login, scan progress, identity display, logout, and expired-code refresh. ([#16736](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16736)) by @wenshao - Adds QQ channel configuration and an optional QR-login management flow that lets the Web Shell bind accounts by scanning a QR code. ([#16724](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16724)) by @wenshao - Adds a segments array to the public channel delivery resource while keeping existing singular segment fields compatible. ([#16807](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16807)) by @wenshao - Shows turns, output speed, total tokens, and cache hit rate under the Web Shell composer, with hover details and Token Usage panel access. ([#16815](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16815)) by @qqqys ### Bug Fixes - Fixes the CI lint freshness check to compare the full prettier ignore set at the base tip so verdicts are not narrowed incorrectly. ([#16729](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16729)) by @wenshao - Lets an Agent Host safely retry a lost enrollment or Replace command so it finishes with the existing Host instead of failing or creating a duplicate. ([#16722](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16722)) by @wenshao - Rejects malformed authorExclude values on inbound task records before they reach comment delivery, preventing crashes and invalid delivery behavior. ([#16740](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16740)) by @wenshao - Makes CI lint narrowing log a warning when a truncated tree prevents narrowing and handles slash-bearing base refs correctly. ([#16747](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16747)) by @wenshao - Stops fork PR CI failures by keeping Ctrl+C out of the focused shell, giving the Managed Agent test fork 40% of machine memory, and stabilizing lease renewal checks. ([#16150](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16150)) by @TianYuan1024 - Fixes shell command parsing so the self-kill guard and file-permission checks correctly handle ANSI-C escapes and -c option terminators. ([#16540](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16540)) by @yiliang114 - Prevents autofix stale-base updates from restarting automated PR reviews that timed out, avoiding repeated review and base-update cycles. ([#16749](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16749)) by @wenshao - Falls back to the Data table view when a chart renderer fails but inline data is readable, instead of showing the chart as unavailable. ([#16021](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16021)) by @zhangxy-zju - Document export renderer size budgets are raised to the merged bundle size, fixing npm run build failures caused by the post-merge Web Shell increase. ([#16774](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16774)) by @yiliang114 - Idle-only slash commands such as /branch, /cd, /fork, /recap, and /advisor now run when dispatched from an idle Ink TUI session instead of being blocked by app-wide state. ([#16731](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16731)) by @qqqys - The Web Shell slash menu now gives command and Skill names priority, truncating descriptions first while full details remain on hover. ([#16790](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16790)) by @callmeYe - Background and workflow approval requests now trigger a terminal bell or desktop notification when unfocused, honoring general.terminalBell and general.notificationMode. ([#16800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16800)) by @qqqys - The CLI now opens the composer silently when a saved subscription model is unavailable and defers the error to send, showing the gateway response. ([#16798](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16798)) by @liuxuely0626 - fix(core): write auto session titles in the conversation's language ([#16806](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16806)) by @qqqys - fix(cli): show a foreground agent's pending approval in the live panel ([#16809](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16809)) by @qqqys - fix(cli): only enable sandbox debugging for explicit DEBUG values ([#16805](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16805)) by @yiliang114 - Pull requests created with gh pr create are now bound using the directory where the command runs, improving worktree binding accuracy. ([#16725](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16725)) by @wenshao - HTTP Managed Session writer reacquisition now waits for in-flight seals and avoids acquiring a lease while a seal may still settle. ([#16726](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16726)) by @wenshao - Prevents stale sessions from being reported active when their PID is recycled by validating a process-start token on Linux. ([#16128](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16128)) by @yiliang114 - Allows channel config fields to declare an inclusive lower bound so zero values are accepted correctly in validation and range messages. ([#16783](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16783)) by @wenshao ### Performance - perf(memory): drop the bundled auto-memory reference and keep the resident policy ([#16739](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16739)) by @qqqys - GitHub channel's PR state watch and notifications list now use conditional requests and cache unchanged responses to avoid spending quota on unchanged data. ([#16741](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16741)) by @wenshao - Improves managed-agent performance by reducing CSI proof copying, optimizing CSI lookup, and using capped startup polling backoff. ([#16828](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16828)) by @doudouOUC - Improves managed-agent responsiveness by removing redundant read-path queries without changing behavior. ([#16827](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16827)) by @doudouOUC ### Documentation - docs: clarify tool bridge requirements when migrating from tools.core ([#16750](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16750)) by @521Peter - Adds bilingual design proposals for bringing /loop to Managed Sessions, covering schedules and wakeups without changing production behavior. ([#16792](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16792)) by @wenshao - docs(managed-agent): Managed scheduling designs — loop review fixes and external schedulers ([#16796](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16796)) by @wenshao - Corrects design documentation to state wakeDormant false may delay delivery until the next refresh tick rather than stranding pending transitions. ([#16834](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16834)) by @wenshao ### Internal Changes - Renames Managed Agent JDBC persistence implementations to distinguish them from repository interfaces and simplify imports. ([#16759](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16759)) by @doudouOUC - Shares Hosted Harness capability tokens across connectors so feature checks remain consistent without changing connector behavior. ([#16763](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16763)) by @doudouOUC - Reduces all sharded CI lanes to two shards and raises the smoke job cap to 75 minutes while preserving run headroom. ([#16764](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16764)) by @wenshao - Excludes background activation renewal from a Managed Session log test to prevent unrelated log writes from affecting its byte-offset check. ([#16756](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16756)) by @wenshao - Managed Runtime worker HTTP routes now derive from a single route plan, improving consistency between route gating and mounting. ([#16788](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16788)) by @doudouOUC - Removes unused managed-agent-server constructors and helpers without changing runtime behavior. ([#16822](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16822)) by @doudouOUC - Refactors session restore into a shared core so in-process callers can restore workspace sessions without HTTP. Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.1 Source: CLI built from source (same branch/ref as SDK) --- ## Highlights The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022: - Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights - Managed-agent sessions can hold multiple child questions at once, answer them in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. ([#16484](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16484)) - Web Shell adds a task Q&A heatmap and an Ask for details side task that explains pending Ask User Question options without answering. ([#16037](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16037), [#16458](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16458)) - GitHub channel editor adds Repository Filter allowlists and blocklists, while bound PR delivery and plain comment delivery become more reliable. ([#16493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16493), [#16502](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16502), [#16416](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16416)) - Shell tool edits now handle CRLF and Unicode safely in sed substitutions, and cancelled commands report as interrupted while keeping partial output. ([#15701](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15701), [#15836](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15836)) - Managed-agent runtime is faster and less prone to deadlocks, with safer session rename, snapshot publication, storage admission, and lock handling. ([#16480](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16480), [#16478](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16478), [#16376](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16376), [#16489](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16489), [#16447](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16447)) - Upgrade refusals and Advisor startup errors no longer expose embedded credentials, and empty Harness user info is rejected during start and verify. ([#16352](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16352), [#16083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16083)) ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Added FileChanged hooks for local non-managed sessions, reporting add, change, and unlink events for watched files and directories. ([#13969](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969)) by @samuelhsin - CI Failure Patrol now posts visible bilingual notices when it reruns flaky failures or cannot classify them, improving PR feedback. ([#16459](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16459)) by @wenshao - feat(cli): align managed agent basic tools with daemon ([#16445](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16445)) by @doudouOUC - Moves Web Shell session search into the sidebar top row beside View activity and improves narrow-layout behavior. ([#16467](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16467)) by @wenshao - Improves CI triage security by isolating triage agent credentials and routing all triage runs to ECS. ([#16468](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16468)) by @wenshao - Managed-agent sessions can now keep multiple child questions pending, answer child questions in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. ([#16484](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16484)) by @doudouOUC - With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, Ink TUI turns send the continuation round after tool batches and handle queued input and retries. ([#16428](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16428)) by @qqqys - Web Shell composer now offers a task Q&A activity heatmap; clicking a day scrolls the transcript to that day's first Q&A and highlights it. ([#16037](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16037)) by @samuelhsin - Adds a Repository Filter to the GitHub channel editor with allowlist and blocklist modes, URL-friendly entries, and skipped-notification timeline rows. ([#16493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16493)) by @wenshao - Adds an Ask for details action to pending Ask User Question panels in Web Shell, opening a side task that explains options without answering. ([#16458](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16458)) by @wenshao - Reclaims idle channel sessions in serve so cached channel routes no longer exhaust the maxSessions budget. ([#16532](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16532)) by @wenshao - Adds a single-pull-request view by URL for daemon PR-state watch, returning state, mergeability, and head SHA. ([#16530](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16530)) by @wenshao - feat(ci): add disposable external PR runners ([#16513](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16513)) by @yiliang114 - feat(web-shell): show tool arguments and result in expanded cards ([#15435](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15435)) by @BigDaddy1337 ### Bug Fixes - Fixed Managed Agent session rename failures by waiting for an in-flight title delivery to settle instead of returning a 503 error. ([#16447](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16447)) by @yiliang114 - Fixed release blocking by moving audio capture prebuilds to macOS 15 while still producing Apple Silicon and Intel Mac artifacts. ([#16464](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16464)) by @liuxuely0626 - Improved Web Shell Skill suggestions by showing the Skill name as the title and the owning Extension on a separate line. ([#16451](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16451)) by @callmeYe - Fixes CI failures on older PR checkouts by refreshing OpenTUI host assets after unpacking shared builds. ([#16476](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16476)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes Web Shell sidebar layout so session search appears to the right of View activity. ([#16481](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16481)) by @wenshao - fix(channels): deliver plain conversation comments to PR-bound sessions ([#16416](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16416)) by @wenshao - Managed agent storage admission now locks rows through alias keys so concurrent storage requests queue instead of deadlocking. ([#16376](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16376)) by @wenshao - Local Managed journal reads now accept a grown journal prefix even when file timestamps do not change, preventing unnecessary read failures. ([#16483](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16483)) by @wenshao - The shell tool's sed simulation now handles CRLF files and Unicode characters correctly in substitution patterns, preventing failed edits and corruption. ([#15701](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15701)) by @2SinceJuly - CI Maven cache handling now preserves suite results and reports failures clearly when cache setup or write-back fails. ([#15274](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15274)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - After Esc or Ctrl+C, cancelled shell commands are reported as interrupted instead of completed, preserving partial output. ([#15836](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15836)) by @2SinceJuly - Managed agent snapshot publication now waits for an in-progress claim, reducing failed publications caused by deadlocks. ([#16489](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16489)) by @wenshao - VS Code companion now writes only the selected model name and baseUrl, preserving other settings.model values when configuring providers. ([#15829](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15829)) by @2SinceJuly - Web Shell session view now names tool blocks using lifecycle toolName when no other tool name is present, preventing unknown Tool labels. ([#16306](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16306)) by @yiliang114 - Interactive TUI now prompts for background workflow agent tool approvals by opening background-task details, preventing stalled runs. ([#16432](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16432)) by @yiliang114 - Non-interactive, ACP, and channel runs now warn when a prompt stacks more than five skills, delivering the notice without disrupting model replies. ([#16404](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16404)) by @yiliang114 - fix(serve): treat a payload-invalid start reply as a definite refusal ([#16460](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16460)) by @yiliang114 - Startup errors for unavailable Advisor models now sanitize aux-model selectors, hiding embedded credentials and NUL bytes while keeping routing unchanged. ([#16083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16083)) by @yiliang114 - Ctrl+B promoted commands that create the first commit in an unborn repository now register it for Auto-mode amend exemption. ([#16081](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16081)) by @yiliang114 - The publish-triage CI job now recreates Git metadata before checkout, preventing leftover workspace hooks or config from running in credential-bearing steps. ([#16494](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16494)) by @wenshao - fix(core): keep follow-up suggestions in Thai, Lao, Khmer and Myanmar ([#16341](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16341)) by @spped2000 - Enables sandbox image builds on mainland release hosts by detecting the managed egress proxy and using it only when Docker Hub is reachable. ([#16281](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16281)) by @yiliang114 - Keeps the user's instruction as the last content in fresh-turn model requests by moving injected context ahead of it. ([#16274](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16274)) by @yiliang114 - Masks passwords in upgrade command refusal messages and rejects empty Harness user info during start and verify. ([#16352](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16352)) by @wenshao - Fixes managed-host Web Shell issues so shell panes, host status updates, session measurement, and owner navigation behave reliably. ([#16203](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16203)) by @yiliang114 - Keeps channel turns completed when the answer was delivered but the follow-up notice fails, and fails turns only when nothing was delivered. ([#16512](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16512)) by @yiliang114 - Makes GitHub channel bound PR delivery reliable by watching all open bound PRs and continuing polling during public turns. ([#16502](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16502)) by @wenshao - Web Shell now respects optional transport capabilities and keeps local prompt timing correct while waiting for an authoritative user echo. ([#16536](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16536)) by @chiga0 - Web Shell no longer crashes when a UI language lacks relay copy and now falls back to English text. ([#15474](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15474)) by @4ekuct25 - Cursor saves now succeed on filesystems that refuse temporary-file permission changes instead of failing before publishing. ([#16257](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16257)) by @wenshao - fix(ci): route the review/resolve permission gate to the ECS pool ([#16482](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16482)) by @wenshao - fix(cli): restore OpenTUI dialog editing controls ([#15908](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15908)) by @chiga0 - fix(managed-agent): restore two runtime-broker classes to their size ratchet ([#16542](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16542)) by @wenshao - fix(serve): serialize overlapping cleanup retries ([#15482](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15482)) by @jabrailkhalil - fix(memory): match reader advice to the binding index budget ([#15368](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15368)) by @jabrailkhalil - fix(release): derive the next patch when the preview baseline lags latest ([#16470](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16470)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - fix(web-shell): include channel sessions in release dialog ([#16537](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16537)) by @wenshao - Show Anthropic refusal details in finish messages instead of the generic SAFETY notice, while keeping refusal handling fatal. ([#16079](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16079)) by @yiliang114 ### Performance - Improves managed-agent performance by reducing tenant guard locking for ordinary session runtime binding control. ([#16480](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16480)) by @doudouOUC - Improves managed-agent tool execution performance by removing tenant placement locking from ordinary session admission. ([#16478](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16478)) by @doudouOUC - MySQL pools now cache parsed statements by default with cachePrepStmts=true, prepStmtCacheSize=512, and prepStmtCacheSqlLimit=8192 unless already set. ([#16414](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16414)) by @wenshao - Reduces memory use when reading large growing local journals by comparing grown prefixes in 64 KiB chunks. ([#16507](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16507)) by @wenshao ### Documentation - docs(design): correct the daemon PR state transitions design ([#16487](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16487)) by @wenshao ### Internal Changes - Improved interactive foreground-shell test reliability by waiting for composer draft and approval footer to appear before asserting. ([#16455](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16455)) by @yiliang114 - Updated managed-agent lifecycle tests and snapshot publication retries to reduce false failures from deadlocks and lane changes. ([#16446](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16446)) by @yiliang114 - test(serve): cover the workspace_runtime_stop boot-time conjunction ([#16469](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16469)) by @yiliang114 - Adds an internal unit test for Web Shell /settings development route rewriting. ([#16456](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16456)) by @yiliang114 - Managed-agent storage alias key generation and digest handling are now consolidated without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16485](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16485)) by @doudouOUC - Consolidated managed-agent JDBC statement preparation and JSON mapper reuse without changing timeout behavior. ([#16486](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16486)) by @doudouOUC - Internal refactor consolidates CSI statement timeout handling with no user-facing behavior change. ([#16503](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16503)) by @doudouOUC - Internal runtime modules replace inline fully qualified type names with imports, improving readability without changing behavior. ([#16504](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16504)) by @doudouOUC - Makes typecheck projects compile cleanly under the TypeScript 7 native compiler while keeping the existing tsc 5.8 build unchanged. ([#16463](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16463)) by @sorrycc - Moves Runtime binding provisioning, recovery, cleanup, and attestation from RuntimeBrokerService into a dedicated internal collaborator. ([#16501](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16501)) by @doudouOUC - Hardens TUI workspace reconciliation tests by pinning literal workspace exclusions, checking diagnostics, and extending glob spelling coverage. ([#16033](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16033)) by @jianyx1 - Internal Runtime Broker code cleanup that replaces fully qualified names with imports, with no user-facing behavior change.
