  • v0.26.9 2026-11-06
    ▼
    <!-- qwen-release-notes:v2 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Skill installation and activation Skill ZIP uploads, daemon APIs, TypeScript SDK support, bulk activation, and recovery protections make installing and managing Skills more reliable. - Adds PUT /skills/activation and setUserSkillsActivation to enable or disable 1-100 user Skills in one request, with saved preferences and propagation status. ([#16186](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16186)) - Prepares Skill installation for larger archives by adding disk-based ZIP handling and recovery-backup protection to the installer. ([#16421](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16421)) - Adds daemon API routes for installing large Skill ZIPs by upload or host file path and querying installation receipts after failures. ([#16422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16422)) - Adds TypeScript SDK support for installing Skill ZIPs from File, Blob, bytes, or host path, with attempt IDs and receipt lookup. ([#16423](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16423)) - WebShell can now upload Skill ZIP archives from the Skills page, show daemon limits, and check uncertain installation results. ([#16424](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424)) ## Web Shell sessions and composer Web Shell session titles, Add menu polish, draft preservation, batch deletion, and listSessions pagination fixes improve everyday session management. - Keeps Web Shell sidebar session titles visible when a transcript is rebuilt, preventing session names from disappearing. ([#16299](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16299)) - Polishes the Web Shell composer Add menu with consistent icons, labels, descriptions, spacing, and improved accessibility for actions and Plan state. ([#16181](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16181)) ![Main menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/d37bb0579f3c6b212c2a18d76acc59af920279fb/composer-menu-16155/before-dark.png) ![Updated production-package menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/d37bb0579f3c6b212c2a18d76acc59af920279fb/composer-menu-16155/after-dark.png) - WebShell now preserves unsent drafts when ArrowUp or ArrowDown moves through wrapped prompt lines before history navigation. ([#14909](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14909)) - web-shell: batch session deletions at the route limit ([#14637](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14637)) ![Before bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/before.png) ![After bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/after.png) - listSessions pagination no longer skips sessions when multiple session files share the same modification time. ([#16024](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16024)) ## Managed agents and sessions Managed agent automation, durable questions, activation renewals, writer recovery, and history caching improve hosted session reliability and speed. - managed-agent: support durable structured user questions ([#16433](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16433)) - managed-agent: enable automation by default ([#16448](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16448)) - Managed agent activation renewals now locate the activation lease more efficiently, reducing renewal lookup overhead. ([#16336](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16336)) - Improves managed-agent performance by removing tenant guard locks from native journal snapshot publication. ([#16410](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16410)) - Managed Session history rebuilds now cache message bodies per process, reducing repeated reads and improving performance for hosted turns. ([#16337](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16337)) - HTTP Managed Session writer recovery now keeps a live in-flight renewal grant instead of unnecessarily re-acquiring the writer. ([#16287](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16287)) ## GitHub PR automation Sandboxed /verify can read PR review threads, /autofix-pr refusals expose machine-readable codes, and GitHub inbound recovery retries failed reads. - The sandboxed /verify round can now see PR review threads, including resolved and outdated threads, so reviewer findings are available during verification. ([#16300](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16300)) - /autofix-pr helper refusals now include a machine-readable refused code and next step on stderr, making failures easier to handle. ([#16238](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16238)) - GitHub inbound recovery now retries after a failed read instead of stopping, so recovered tasks run once the task store becomes readable. ([#16402](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16402)) ## Model and provider support Image input fixes for Llama, LLaVA, Pixtral, Mistral Small, and Qwen VL models plus OCI Generative AI documentation broaden provider coverage. - Enables image input for Llama 3.2 Vision, Llama 4, LLaVA, Pixtral, and Mistral Small 3.1 and 3.2 models. ([#16311](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16311)) - core: accept images for Qwen VL models under their Ollama names ([#16309](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16309)) - providers: document OCI Generative AI under OpenAI-compatible providers ([#16345](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16345)) ## Channels and messaging QQ proactive delivery and richer Channel event timeline recording improve active group messaging, delivery tracking, and scan health visibility. - Enables QQ proactive delivery so loop messages, webhook tasks, background responses, and daemon sends can be sent as active group messages. ([#15635](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15635)) - Channel event timeline now records private bound-session deliveries, undelivered events, and scan health outcomes. ([#16237](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16237)) ## CLI and terminal status Interactive CLI reports working, blocked, done, or error status via OSC 7501, while experimental.unifiedAgentLoop helps Ink TUI finish tool batches. - The interactive CLI now reports working, blocked, done, or error status to terminals using OSC 7501 with app=qwen-code. ([#16407](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16407)) - With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, Ink TUI turns await their shared tool batch so tool continuations complete within the turn. ([#16385](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16385)) ## Daemon, runtime, and account recovery Faster SSH registration and MCP startup, reduced tool-execution locking, bounded daemon replay memory, and subscription recovery improve platform stability. - SSH registration settlement and Session worktree preparation are less serialized, allowing more concurrent Runtime work and faster workspace preparation. ([#16386](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16386)) - Loads MCP client Google auth providers on demand to reduce startup load while keeping configured server behavior unchanged. ([#16242](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16242)) - Improves ordinary session tool execution performance by reducing unnecessary locking during admission and dispatch. ([#16415](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16415)) - Daemon command and skill replay now limits snapshot memory with an 8 MiB per-session ring, configurable via --event-ring-max-bytes. ([#16413](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16413)) - subscription: isolate activation and restore sign-in recovery ([#16453](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16453)) ## Other Changes - Internal test coverage for renewal recovery and writer seal handling was hardened without changing production behavior. ([#14482](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14482)) - Consolidates Web Shell sidebar test scaffolding onto a shared sidebarHarness without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16016](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16016)) - Adds a design proposal for moving PR state transition detection from GitHub channel polling to the daemon PR refresh timer. ([#16246](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16246)) - Shortens the stale PR policy to mark pull requests stale after 30 inactive days and close them after 14 more days, with a larger sweep budget. ([#16435](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16435)) - Fixes release Docker integration builds to use the same apt-mirror probe as E2E builds, improving mirror selection and cache reliability. ([#16278](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16278)) - The no-AK integration gate now runs on the self-hosted ECS pool for every pull request, including untrusted forks. ([#16132](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16132)) - test(managed-agent): cover pending sibling approval holds ([#15994](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15994)) - ci: build the PR tree once and shorten the required path ([#16450](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16450)) ![Screenshot from pull request 16450](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a78d1c35-4957-416a-92aa-e3c642125344) ![Screenshot from pull request 16450](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51886ce5-eee8-422e-9a96-03e524b77bbf) --- ## 中文摘要 ### Skill 安装与激活 Skill ZIP 上传、daemon API、TypeScript SDK 支持、批量激活与恢复备份保护，让 Skill 安装和管理更可靠。 - 新增 PUT /skills/activation 与 setUserSkillsActivation，可一次启用或禁用 1-100 个用户 Skill，并返回保存与传播状态。 ([#16186](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16186)) - 为大型 Skill 压缩包安装做准备，在安装器中加入从磁盘读取 ZIP 的能力与恢复备份保护。 ([#16421](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16421)) - 新增守护进程 API，可通过上传或主机文件路径安装大型 Skill ZIP，并在失败后查询安装回执。 ([#16422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16422)) - TypeScript SDK 支持通过 File、Blob、字节或主机路径安装 Skill ZIP，并提供尝试 ID 与回执查询。 ([#16423](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16423)) - WebShell 现在可从 Skills 页面上传 Skill ZIP，显示守护进程限制，并查询不确定的安装结果。 ([#16424](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424)) ### Web Shell 会话与输入 Web Shell 会话标题、Add 菜单细节、草稿保留、批量删除与 listSessions 分页修复改进日常会话管理。 - 当 transcript 重建时保留 Web Shell 会话列表标题，避免会话名称丢失。 ([#16299](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16299)) - 优化 Web Shell 作曲器 Add 菜单的图标、标签、描述、间距，并改进无障碍展示与 Plan 状态指示。 ([#16181](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16181)) - WebShell 现在在 ArrowUp 或 ArrowDown 浏览换行提示行时保留未发送草稿。 ([#14909](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14909)) - web-shell: batch session deletions at the route limit ([#14637](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14637)) - listSessions 分页在多个会话文件修改时间相同时不再跳过会话。 ([#16024](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16024)) ### Managed agent 与会话 Managed agent 自动化、持久用户问题、activation 续期、writer 恢复与历史缓存提升托管会话的可靠性与性能。 - managed-agent: support durable structured user questions ([#16433](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16433)) - managed-agent: enable automation by default ([#16448](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16448)) - Managed agent 激活续期现在能更高效定位 activation lease，降低查询开销。 ([#16336](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16336)) - 通过移除 native journal 快照发布中的 tenant 守卫锁，提升 managed-agent 性能。 ([#16410](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16410)) - Managed Session 历史重建现在按进程缓存消息正文，减少重复读取并提升性能。 ([#16337](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16337)) - HTTP Managed Session 写入方恢复现在会保留有效的在途续期授权，避免不必要重新获取。 ([#16287](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16287)) ### GitHub PR 自动化 沙箱 /verify 可读取 PR review threads，/autofix-pr 拒绝输出机器可读代码，GitHub 入站恢复在读取失败后重试。 - 沙箱 /verify 轮次现在可读取 PR review threads，包括已解决和过期讨论，便于验证时参考评审意见。 ([#16300](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16300)) - /autofix-pr 助手拒绝时会在 stderr 输出 refused 代码和 next 步骤，便于自动处理。 ([#16238](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16238)) - GitHub 入站恢复在读取失败后会继续重试，任务存储可读后已恢复任务将运行。 ([#16402](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16402)) ### 模型与 Provider 支持 Llama、LLaVA、Pixtral、Mistral Small 与 Qwen VL 图像输入修复，以及 OCI Generative AI 文档扩展 provider 覆盖。 - Llama 3.2 Vision、Llama 4、LLaVA、Pixtral 及 Mistral Small 3.1/3.2 支持图像输入。 ([#16311](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16311)) - core: accept images for Qwen VL models under their Ollama names ([#16309](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16309)) - providers: document OCI Generative AI under OpenAI-compatible providers ([#16345](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16345)) ### Channel 与消息 QQ 主动消息投递与更完整的 Channel 事件时间线记录改进群消息、投递跟踪和扫描健康可见性。 - QQ 支持主动消息投递，循环、webhook、后台任务和 daemon 发送可作为主动群消息发出。 ([#15635](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15635)) - Channel 事件时间线现在记录私有绑定会话投递、未投递事件和扫描健康结果。 ([#16237](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16237)) ### CLI 与终端状态 交互式 CLI 通过 OSC 7501 报告 working、blocked、done 或 error 状态，experimental.unifiedAgentLoop 帮助 Ink TUI 完成工具批处理。 - 交互式 CLI 现在通过 OSC 7501 向终端报告 working、blocked、done 或 error 状态，并标记 app=qwen-code。 ([#16407](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16407)) - 启用 experimental.unifiedAgentLoop 后，Ink TUI 回合会等待共享工具批处理完成。 ([#16385](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16385)) ### Daemon、Runtime 与账户恢复 SSH 注册、MCP 启动、工具执行锁与 daemon 回放内存限制优化，以及 subscription 恢复改进平台稳定性。 - SSH 注册结算与 Session worktree 准备减少串行限制，支持更多并发 Runtime 工作。 ([#16386](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16386)) - 按需加载 MCP 客户端的 Google auth providers，降低启动负载且配置服务器行为不变。 ([#16242](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16242)) - 通过减少普通会话工具执行准入与调度中的不必要锁，提高执行性能。 ([#16415](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16415)) - 守护进程命令和技能回放限制快照内存，默认每会话 8 MiB，可用 --event-ring-max-bytes 配置。 ([#16413](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16413)) - subscription: isolate activation and restore sign-in recovery ([#16453](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16453)) ### 其他变更 - 增强续期恢复与 writer seal 的测试覆盖，不改变生产行为。 ([#14482](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14482)) - 将 Web Shell 侧边栏测试脚手架合并到共享 sidebarHarness，不影响用户可见行为。 ([#16016](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16016)) - 新增设计提案，将 PR 状态变化检测从 GitHub 频道轮询迁移到 daemon 的 PR 刷新定时器。 ([#16246](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16246)) - 将 stale PR 策略缩短为 30 天无活动标记、再过 14 天关闭，并提高单次清理预算。 ([#16435](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16435)) - 修复 release Docker 集成构建，使其与 E2E 一样使用 apt-mirror 探测，提升镜像选择与缓存可靠性。 ([#16278](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16278)) - no-AK 集成门禁现在对所有 pull request 路由到自托管 ECS 池，包括不受信任分支。 ([#16132](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16132)) - test(managed-agent): cover pending sibling approval holds ([#15994](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15994)) - ([#16256](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16256)) by @doudouOUC - Narrows managed-agent lock scopes for output, lifecycle, and storage updates to reduce contention and improve throughput. Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.1 Source: CLI built from source (same branch/ref as SDK) --- ## Highlights The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022: - Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Adds an operator-scoped model.catalogRefresh setting and lets privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false stop background catalog refreshes while local metadata remains available. ([#16066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16066)) by @yiliang114 - feat(managed-agent): support full model configuration at session creation ([#16153](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16153)) by @doudouOUC - When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, ACP Goal turns run on the shared agent loop with shared rounds, tool batches, and stop points. ([#16131](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16131)) by @qqqys - Adds a Channel events page to Web Shell with a filterable, auto-refreshing timeline of Channel activity, skip reasons, replies, task transitions, and poll results. ([#16106](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16106)) by @wenshao - Adds a local /verify-pr Docker recipe that runs untrusted PR code in a container while keeping model credentials on the host through a chat-completion proxy. ([#16077](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16077)) by @wenshao - Runs Mods prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal before typed prompts are processed, allowing hooks to see composer text with pasted content expanded. ([#16180](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16180)) by @qqqys - Adds a managed Web Shell host entry, improves managed empty-state layout, and consolidates session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices above the composer. ([#15928](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15928)) by @yiliang114 - Adds Settings → Connections → Allow remote connections to qwen serve, enabling remote access, token use, and client disconnects without restarting. ([#15887](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15887)) by @yiliang114 - With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, ACP cron and background-notification turns now use the shared agent loop for consistent rounds, tool batching, and stopping. ([#16190](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16190)) by @qqqys - Workspace uploads can now proceed concurrently while still rejecting occupied destinations and preserving directory occupancy protections. ([#16212](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16212)) by @doudouOUC - GitHub events for bound PRs now go to the associated session as untrusted prompts, and replies stay private unless published. ([#16117](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16117)) by @wenshao - Web Shell channel editor can now edit GitHub repository access, mention behavior, and notification polling settings instead of requiring manual settings changes. ([#16149](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16149)) by @wenshao ### Bug Fixes - Pins the RHEL 10 EPEL bootstrap RPM and makes desktop smoke teardown treat Linux zombie processes as stopped while still reporting live daemon failures. ([#16154](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16154)) by @yiliang114 - Compacts live ACP tool-result displays for session replay, so large file edit results show a saved-session preview instead of full old and new contents. ([#16172](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16172)) by @wenshao - Fixes PR review endpoint routing by selecting the cohort before the model and reports the final bucket, cohort, model, and endpoint hostname. ([#16151](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16151)) by @yiliang114 - fix(serve): keep record_artifact guidance out of Managed Runtime worker results ([#16148](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16148)) by @wenshao - Binds web-shell config synchronization to the current attachment so config writes made by the first prompt are no longer silently discarded. ([#16170](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16170)) by @wenshao - Fixes tool-choice failures on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, and Mythos 5.1 by avoiding unsupported forced tool selection. ([#15558](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15558)) by @Adkid-Zephyr - Fixes Web Shell pasting so a single copied image with an HTTP(S) URL attaches the image, while unavailable file pastes show a warning. ([#16179](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16179)) by @ytahdn - Requires explicit folder trust before repository-supplied hooks, permission grants, and project language servers can run, improving safety for untrusted projects. ([#16182](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16182)) by @yiliang114 - Anthropic-compatible requests now honor the configured transport timeout and dispatcher, preventing premature request aborts when a longer API timeout is set. ([#16193](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16193)) by @yiliang114 - Remote-access error handling now hides internal error details from callers and fixes several reviewed reliability and security defects. ([#16199](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16199)) by @yiliang114 - On touch devices, navigation now keeps focus on the chat pane instead of opening the composer keyboard, while desktop focus behavior remains unchanged. ([#16198](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16198)) by @ytahdn - The bundled Generated UI MCP server now runs correctly in Node mode when the CLI is launched from an Electron-based IDE companion. ([#16064](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16064)) by @yar3333 - ACP bridge operations that finish alongside long-lived session or channel events now clean up their results instead of retaining them. ([#15347](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15347)) by @Sumire-no-kai - Ordinary workspace execution, member release, and file rewind no longer take the tenant-wide placement lock, reducing cross-workspace blocking. ([#16205](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16205)) by @doudouOUC - Embedded-webview bundle guard failures now show a readable assertion naming the forbidden marker instead of crashing on a large diff. ([#16210](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16210)) by @yiliang114 - Project hooks in .qwen/settings.json now require explicit folder or workspace trust in interactive sessions and show a warning when withheld. ([#16196](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16196)) by @yiliang114 - OpenRouter IDs with :exacto now keep the base model name, so qwen/qwen3-coder:exacto gets its 262,144-token window instead of 200K. ([#16165](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16165)) by @Shizoqua - Shell permission analysis now treats grep -n and grep --line-number as flags, so grep file reads are still checked. ([#14383](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14383)) by @kabishou11 - Monitor and workflow completion notifications are attributed to the registering turn, letting active-turn results reach the next model request sooner. ([#16177](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16177)) by @yiliang114 - Makes CI sandbox image builds more reliable on hosts with slow default Debian mirrors by switching to a faster mirror only when speed checks require it. ([#16218](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16218)) by @yiliang114 - Scopes GitHub, GitLab, and DWS polling cursors to each workspace, preserving existing positions on upgrade while storing channel state with stricter permissions. ([#16231](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16231)) by @wenshao - Improves CI apt mirror selection by preferring the VPC intranet mirror and switching when a candidate is fast enough, even if the default mirror seems acceptable. ([#16260](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16260)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes RHEL 10 desktop smoke tests by running them headless without requiring Xvfb. ([#16211](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16211)) by @yiliang114 ### Performance - Managed Agent resident Runtime Session claim and release no longer wait on the tenant placement lock, improving resident runtime performance without changing success behavior. ([#16217](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16217)) by @doudouOUC - Managed Agent turn submission admission and migration preparation avoid the tenant placement lock where safe, reducing wait time without changing request outcomes. ([#16223](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16223)) by @doudouOUC - Standalone Harness admission, recovery, cleanup, and Hook admission checks no longer take the tenant placement lock, improving Managed Agent performance with unchanged verdicts. ([#16221](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16221)) by @doudouOUC - Speeds up local Workspace file reads, uploads, and status checks by reusing CLI capability probes when local CLI identity is unchanged. ([#16229](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16229)) by @doudouOUC - Improves Session responsiveness by reducing locking for common commands such as model changes, approvals, context compression, task cancel, and renames. ([#16225](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16225)) by @doudouOUC ### Documentation - Release documentation now explains why publish can remain queued on GitHub-hosted runners and why those steps are not moved to ECS pools. ([#16194](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16194)) by @yiliang114 - Managed Agent structure-review documentation now reflects the completed store decomposition and current audit status. ([#16230](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16230)) by @wenshao ### Internal Changes - Adds an /autofix-pr chain test for rerunning a timed-out job when the rerun answer is lost. ([#16138](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16138)) by @wenshao - Makes Local, SSH, Kubernetes, External, and Static runtime backends optional so embedded servers can include only needed backends; pending operations resume when available. ([#16141](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16141)) by @doudouOUC - Simplifies managed-agent row locking and runtime verification while preserving session, turn, journal, and checkpoint validation order. ([#16139](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16139)) by @doudouOUC - Refactors internal Managed Agent session-store consumers to narrower role interfaces without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16121](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16121)) by @wenshao - Adds regression tests covering removal of active persistent permission rules, including post-removal decisions and preservation of unrelated rules. ([#13818](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13818)) by @TYY-2005 - Pins hook telemetry redaction tests with value-level assertions so future raw-text properties fail instead of leaking. ([#11785](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11785)) by @RunMintOn - Reserves Hosted integration-test ports below ephemeral ranges to reduce port conflicts and improve test reliability. ([#16174](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16174)) by @wenshao - Adds a regression test ensuring completed background shell notifications reach the next model request in the same turn without starting extra notification turns. ([#16176](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16176)) by @yiliang114 - ci(e2e): run the nightly suite with the unified agent loop on ([#16192](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16192)) by @qqqys - Managed Agent's shared MySQL schema now follows documented conventions for identifiers, booleans, counters, indexes, and digests, improving SQL consistency. ([#16143](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16143)) by @doudouOUC - EmbeddedRuntimeBroker now depends only on SessionQueryStore, simplifying Managed Agent internals without changing user-facing behavior. ([#16216](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16216)) by @wenshao - Integration tests now install the local extension fixture from a dedicated subdirectory, fixing E2E failures caused by copying the extension store into itself. ([#16222](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16222)) by @yiliang114 - Improves managed-agent test reliability by refreshing Workspace owner membership expectations for concurrent sessions. ([#16240](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16240)) by @doudouOUC - Fixes ACP parity tests by keeping session runtime state out of the compared workspace directory. ([#16224](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16224)) by @yiliang114 ## New Contributors - @TYY-2005 made their first contribution in [#13818](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13818) - @RunMintOn made their first contribution in [#11785](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11785) - @Adkid-Zephyr made their first contribution in [#15558](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15558) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/compare/v0.26.6...v0.26.7

    <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Adds a Web Shell sidebar activity view for trusted workspace conversations, showing approval/input/error states, unread completions, running work, and bulk read/archive controls. ([#16022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16022)) by @deggs7 - Adds an "Add to Split View" option to eligible sidebar session menus in web shell, making it easier to open sessions side by side. ([#15956](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15956)) by @4ekuct25 - Adds request success rate, output speed, per-model success indicators, and distinct model colors to the Web Shell token usage panel. ([#16108](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16108)) by @qqqys - Web Shell composer shows a dismissible Workflow chip that turns Workflow mode off, warns when tools are unavailable, and summarizes the mode in the + menu. ([#16107](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16107)) by @qqqys - Web Shell Token Usage now plots per-request output speed, first-token latency, and failure details by model, making session performance and errors easier to inspect. ([#16111](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16111)) by @qqqys - With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, more ACP turns, including channel prompts and Goal-proposal approvals, run on the shared loop. ([#15902](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15902)) by @qqqys - Mods can now run prompt.submit hooks in headless runs for -p prompts and stream-json user messages, allowing prompt inspection or rewriting before submission. ([#15905](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15905)) by @qqqys - Desktop releases now publish Fedora 44 and RHEL 10 x64 RPM installers alongside existing Linux packages. ([#16060](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16060)) by @yiliang114 - feat(web-shell): make GitHub channel configuration usable ([#16096](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16096)) by @wenshao - feat(verify-pr): inherit --publish consent on same-session re-verification ([#16112](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16112)) by @wenshao - feat(ci): let the PR review canary cohort carry its own endpoint ([#16130](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16130)) by @yiliang114 ### Bug Fixes - OAuth refresh lock cleanup now removes the lock only when the current process owns it, preventing exiting processes from deleting active refresh locks. ([#15661](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15661)) by @2SinceJuly - MCP tool discovery now skips duplicate tool names but keeps all uniquely named tools, preventing one name collision from hiding an entire server's tools. ([#15757](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15757)) by @2SinceJuly - The Web Shell Plugins page now shows a back control when the navigation rail is unavailable, letting users return to chat from compact layouts. ([#15651](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15651)) by @2SinceJuly - LSP code-navigation queries now fail with an explicit reason when no language server is ready instead of returning empty results. ([#15946](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15946)) by @404khai - The verify report now counts targeted gate test-suite results separately from a round's scripted assertions, making assertion totals reflect only round checks. ([#16013](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16013)) by @wenshao - Makes long /btw answers scroll in a bounded panel with mouse wheel, Shift+Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, and a scrollbar, while short answers remain unchanged. ([#15982](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15982)) by @2SinceJuly - Fixes verify-pr to count each suite run as one assertion and handle skip notices on closed PRs so review rounds are not rejected with zero assertions. ([#16050](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16050)) by @wenshao - Fixes Kimi K3 generation recognition so supported IDs use the 1,000,000-token context window, while k3-256k keeps its 256K window. ([#16048](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16048)) by @wenshao - Fixes review command so plain-language re-review requests target the intended PR and do not misread resume flags or file-like tokens. ([#15998](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15998)) by @wenshao - Installs DejaVu fonts in the sandbox so capture cards use the intended monospace font and render legibly. ([#16032](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16032)) by @yiliang114 - Moves the Workflow mode toggle from the composer toolbar into the composer “+” menu to reduce toolbar clutter while keeping it accessible. ([#16047](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16047)) by @qqqys - Improves managed-agent recovery accuracy by blocking gap fills without child ledger evidence and clarifying unknown or never-started states. ([#16015](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16015)) by @wenshao - Fixes managed-agent child result delivery status so consumed child results are no longer marked pending. ([#16074](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16074)) by @wenshao - Fixes AI attribution notes for loosely spelled git commit --amend commands so they diff against the amended commit, not earlier commits. ([#16073](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16073)) by @yiliang114 - Makes loop-protection reminder delivery and telemetry settle only when the model request carrying the reminder is accepted, preventing premature clearing or logging. ([#15559](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15559)) by @suzhiguo7 - fix(core): don't treat fd duplication (2>&1) as a file write in shell permission checks ([#15681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15681)) by @Suaroman - Sanitizes goal approval text and edit-diff file paths in Web Shell by escaping control and bidi characters so displayed approval content cannot carry hidden controls. ([#16080](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16080)) by @yiliang114 - Shows Managed Session list failures as a localized Retry notice with request details and avoids the empty state until loading succeeds. ([#16082](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16082)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes invalid Javadoc left after the module split so the managed-agent release profile can build documentation again. ([#16099](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16099)) by @doudouOUC - Moves the Web Shell managed session list failure notice below the Sessions / Archived tabs and prevents its request id from being cut off. ([#16104](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16104)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes qwen-managed-agent-upgrade start and verify so they reach the control plane and Hosted Harness using the server's resolved endpoint configuration. ([#16051](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16051)) by @wenshao - Tightens the Web Shell mobile composer layout by aligning workspace controls, truncating long names, and centering the context-usage ring. ([#16103](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16103)) by @ytahdn - VS Code companion session history now groups This Week by the current calendar week, so earlier sessions are placed in Older instead of incorrectly appearing under This Week. ([#16097](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16097)) by @yiliang114 - The bundled review skill now tells fetch-pr to re-run with both --since and --since-model and removes the retired range model, preventing incomplete anchors. ([#16094](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16094)) by @yiliang114 - The Managed runtime release workflow can now rebuild the missing 0.26.5 runtime from its original tag after repairing the Javadoc issue that blocked the release. ([#16114](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16114)) by @doudouOUC - Windows installer updates now stop the bundled runtime before replacing files, reducing update failures when node.exe remains locked. ([#16071](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16071)) by @yiliang114 - Channel users can now /approve or /deny their own pending one-time tool permission requests in the current attended turn. ([#16087](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16087)) by @BenGuanRan - Linux AppImage builds now verify required dynamic libraries are bundled or documented as host-provided, helping prevent missing-library failures. ([#16062](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16062)) by @yiliang114 - Mods that register prompt.paint or ui.place hooks now load successfully, with those unsupported hooks skipped instead of stopping startup. ([#16124](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16124)) by @qqqys - fix(mcp): warn about disabled tool typos on every discovery path ([#16120](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16120)) by @yiliang114 - fix(managed-agent): Restore profile-owned runtime verification ([#16134](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16134)) by @doudouOUC - fix(core): attribute background shell notifications to the registering turn ([#16125](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16125)) by @yiliang114 - fix(core): report redirects on cd segments ([#16129](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16129)) by @yiliang114 ### Documentation - Updates daemon usage documentation with current deployment, security, authenticated startup, token sidecar lifecycle, and lifecycle-command guidance. ([#16056](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16056)) by @wenshao - Adds a README quickstart for daemon mode covering qwen serve startup, status/log/stop commands, default loopback binding, and local security warnings. ([#16053](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16053)) by @wenshao - Updates managed-agent structure-review documentation to reflect the Runtime Broker extraction and newly separated recovery, reconciliation, and cancellation components. ([#16109](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16109)) by @wenshao - ManagedAgentStore documentation now reflects the completed store conversion and removes outdated setter descriptions. ([#16118](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16118)) by @wenshao ### Internal Changes - Public and WebShell Session event streams now share replay and live delivery while keeping existing payloads, event names, and delivery order. ([#15952](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15952)) by @doudouOUC - ci: route the classify_pr gate to ECS for every pull request ([#16019](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16019)) by @yiliang114 - Adds an end-to-end test for /autofix-pr watch helpers against real git and a fake gh to improve automated fix reliability. ([#16017](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16017)) by @wenshao - Adds a managed-agent contract test asserting A3 sibling call binding and approval snapshot consistency, with no production behavior change. ([#15995](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15995)) by @wang1408 - Makes Windows preview installer tests run reliably through cmd.exe so nightly results are reported correctly. ([#16028](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16028)) by @yiliang114 - Improves managed-agent broker reliability by separating runtime execution workflows. ([#16029](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16029)) by @doudouOUC - Makes managed-agent session store initialization safer by using constructor dependency injection. ([#16061](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16061)) by @doudouOUC - test(managed-agent): gate the expired-cursor resync answer ([#16076](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16076)) by @wenshao - Refactors Managed Agent runtime execution to centralize dispatch, cancellation, and completion tracking in an internal dispatcher. ([#16084](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16084)) by @doudouOUC - Adds a Managed Agent test verifying mcp-release refusal and same-id retry behavior when a session uses two MCP servers. ([#16089](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16089)) by @wenshao - Adds a managed-agent test verifying detach is refused while a tool result is unknown and the session remains attached. ([#16098](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16098)) by @wenshao - Reconnects Hosted fault probes to current execution owners so managed-agent tests observe dispatch, cancellation, and delayed replies accurately. ([#16101](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16101)) by @doudouOUC - Settings documentation now matches the runtime schema, and memory.enableAutoSkill and security.auth.useExternal are correctly shown as false. ([#16085](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16085)) by @yiliang114 - Windows installation PATH persistence is now protected by a contract test, reducing the chance that a fresh install fails to remain on PATH. ([#16072](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16072)) by @yiliang114 - Managed Agent storage was reorganized into Agent and Session stores without changing user-visible behavior. ([#16090](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16090)) by @doudouOUC - refactor(managed-agent): trim store delegation boilerplate ([#16142](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16142)) by @doudouOUC ## New Contributors - @404khai made their first contribution in [#15946](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15946) - @wang1408 made their first contribution in [#15995](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15995) - @suzhiguo7 made their first contribution in [#15559](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15559) - @Suaroman made their first contribution in [#15681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15681) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/compare/v0.26.5...v0.26.6

Highlights The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022: - Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed. - Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost. ## Bundled CLI Version This SDK release bundles CLI version: 0.23.0 Source: latest stable CLI from     <!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 --> ## Highlights _See the complete change list below._ ## Breaking Changes No known breaking changes. ## Complete Change List ### Features - Adds bounded SQL history queries for Managed local H2 and Hosted MySQL, enabling paged recent messages, journal transactions, and exact operation or command lookups. ([#15839](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15839)) by @doudouOUC - Enables Generated UI by default and lets users continue chatting with interactive card values attached as removable context above the composer. ([#15856](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15856)) by @qqqys - feat(web-shell): keyboard shortcuts for Session Overview and Split View ([#14179](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14179)) by @4ekuct25 - Adds a Russian locale for the Web Shell Goal card and Goals dialog, with English fallback for untranslated strings. ([#13685](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13685)) by @4ekuct25 - Extends Web Shell one-click daemon updates to pnpm, yarn, bun, and sudo-prefixed npm installs, and shows manual steps when automatic update is unavailable. ([#15849](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15849)) by @wenshao - Web Shell and Qwen Code Desktop now show active background agent counts in the status-bar task pill while agents are running. ([#14002](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14002)) by @4ekuct25 - Managed WebShell now reads the latest 100 live items directly and pages upward for older messages, while live updates continue. ([#15865](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15865)) by @doudouOUC - The /verify-pr local flow now reuses the current working tree only when it is a clean checkout of the PR head and records round details. ([#15913](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15913)) by @wenshao - Archived conversations in Settings now show Export conversation and Restore inline beside More, making archive management faster. ([#15872](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15872)) by @deggs7 - PR watch now merges a stale base before attempting fixes when CI failures may be caused by the branch being behind. ([#15922](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15922)) by @wenshao - Adds an experimental one-command Helm deployment for Managed Agent with Hosted Harness, MySQL, local execution, and an authenticated gateway. ([#15492](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15492)) by @doudouOUC - Adds --in-place mode to the PR-watch skill to co-drive in your checkout, push the branch, and reply on the PR. ([#15929](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15929)) by @wenshao - Keeps skill slash-command argument hints visible while typing and shrinks them to missing arguments. ([#15930](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15930)) by @wenshao - Makes context memory files in the Context Usage panel clickable to open read-only previews such as AGENTS.md. ([#15932](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15932)) by @wenshao - Makes autofix-pr post a pull-request comment when a round is blocked, stating what was attempted, what blocks it, and what human action is needed. ([#15978](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15978)) by @wenshao - Adds a retry budget to /autofix-pr so a check left failing after three fix pushes is handed to a human and shown in /autofix-pr status. ([#15985](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15985)) by @wenshao - Adds a Workflow switch in Web Shell, split panes, and VS Code chat to update saved session Workflow preferences for the next turn without interrupting responses. ([#15779](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15779)) by @qqqys - Enables channel adapters to expose tools to agent sessions and adds QQ moderation tools, including recall, mute, kick, and join approval, controlled by moderationTools. ([#14348](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14348)) by @Eric-GoodBoy-Tech - Adds a batch request and SDK method to fetch live-session snapshots for up to 20 selected workspaces in one call. ([#12513](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12513)) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI - feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery ([#11486](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/11486)) by @XIQIXIQIXIQI - Improves the bundled code-review skill by re-anchoring after head drift, running actionlint checks, accounting for blockers, and refusing retries. ([#16001](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16001)) by @wenshao ### Bug Fixes - Hardens the managed-agent upgrade command's check, backup, install, start, and verify phases, including cleanup after interrupted installs. ([#15853](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15853)) by @wenshao - TUI CI now runs impact-selected checks and reserves full source TUI acceptance for nightly runs, manual dispatch, and high-risk changes. ([#15864](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15864)) by @yiliang114 - Main pushes now run one macOS E2E shard instead of two, while schedules, manual dispatch, and feat/e2e branches keep the two-shard matrix. ([#15873](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15873)) by @yiliang114 - The Web Shell floating approval card for tool approvals now uses a single scroll region, avoiding nested scrollbars in long diffs. ([#14621](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14621)) by @4ekuct25 - Release builds and eligible downstream jobs now use labelled runners on existing ECS hosts to reduce hosted-runner queue delays. ([#15832](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15832)) by @yiliang114 - CUA input, window selection, and session cleanup align with 0.27.0 across CUA SDK, Browser SDK, and Node REPL for more reliable sessions. ([#15784](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15784)) by @LaZzyMan - Review command tests now pin ghApiAllNested pagination and response merging behavior to prevent regressions in GitHub API requests. ([#12560](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/12560)) by @indexGin - The No-workspace sessions header now matches Pinned, Workspaces, and Recent with consistent height, muted text, spacing, chevron, and hover/focus behavior. ([#15897](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15897)) by @deggs7 - E2E builds now use the same pool-first runner routing and disk gate as other jobs, reducing hosted queue delays for post-merge test signals. ([#15885](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15885)) by @yiliang114 - Web Shell browser smoke tests now run on isolated ubuntu-latest runners to avoid shared-runner network failures. ([#15886](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15886)) by @yiliang114 - Web Shell now hides the No-workspace sessions sidebar section when it loads empty, matching Pinned behavior. ([#15916](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15916)) by @deggs7 - fix(web-shell): keep "+ Add session" clickable when the catalog is empty ([#15835](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15835)) by @2SinceJuly - fix(ci): weight PR owner assignment by open issue load ([#15194](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15194)) by @DragonnZhang - fix(cli): separate instruction files from auto memory in context usage ([#15863](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15863)) by @callmeYe - fix(core): skip memory imports of files already loaded as context files ([#15687](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15687)) by @tneemo - fix(core): retry bodyless 400 responses instead of treating them as fail-fast ([#15821](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15821)) by @Andrea-Bruno - fix(cli): share hosted harness deadlines and bail after CI retries ([#14752](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14752)) by @zonemeen - fix(web-shell): prune split panes whose session left the active catalog ([#14577](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14577)) by @4ekuct25 - fix(core): stop the session LSP client on Config shutdown ([#14778](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14778)) by @he-yufeng - Session messaging guidance now explains safe-mode suppression or missing peer addresses without implying recipients do not exist. ([#13948](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13948)) by @haomint - Memory writes now report omitted index entries and scan-cap omissions separately, with sample names and preserved warnings. ([#14937](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14937)) by @jabrailkhalil - Web Shell tool-card diffs now wrap long lines so diffs with long comments or paths scroll vertically instead of showing per-line horizontal scrollbars. ([#13272](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13272)) by @ifan855 - /context now displays token counts of one million or more as millions in terminal, plain text, and OpenTUI views. ([#13237](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13237)) by @Shizoqua - Fixed a CLI test-suite build failure by completing the settle-budget rename in hosted harness tests. ([#15935](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15935)) by @wenshao - The sandboxed /verify-pr publisher now runs the artifact check itself and marks the round inconclusive if the check fails or cannot run. ([#15938](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15938)) by @wenshao - Startup probe now separates broker write failures from wrong topic type, giving clearer fail-fast guidance and mqadmin remedy. ([#15941](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15941)) by @wenshao - Fixes /verify-pr publishing to use the newest round and updates skill text to match CI harness-fault behavior. ([#15966](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15966)) by @wenshao - Queues peer-controller registry writes from the same process before taking the cross-process file lock to reduce lock contention and make concurrent updates more reliable. ([#15971](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15971)) by @wenshao - fix(managed-agent): stop a drained pool owner's not-found from retiring automations ([#15990](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15990)) by @wenshao - Routes helper-test temporary files to the runner data-disk temp directory to prevent CI failures caused by a small host /tmp tmpfs. ([#15979](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15979)) by @yiliang114 - Exempts non-TUI package trees from the parity and no-flicker gates so PRs touching only them skip those lanes. ([#15937](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15937)) by @yiliang114 - Fixes session-commit registration when an absolute cd or pushd resolves to the same repository or a subdirectory, keeping commits tracked. ([#15953](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15953)) by @yiliang114 - isAoneHostFamily now uses the shared host normalizer so review remote matching and write routing judge Aone hosts consistently. ([#15934](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15934)) by @yiliang114 - fix(vscode): gate the companion vitest worker cap on the shared pool ([#15940](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15940)) by @yiliang114 - Peer-controller registry writers now wait up to 8s for a contended lock and can take over a crashed holder's lock without losing writes. ([#15992](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15992)) by @wenshao - The CLI now requests consent for native extension commands before direct installation in OpenTUI; replacement or unmount cancels pending requests. ([#15947](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15947)) by @chiga0 - Fixes managed-agent cancellation, Maven embedding, Hosted fault testing, and SDK stream-idle recovery so verification flows behave reliably. ([#15927](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15927)) by @doudouOUC - Makes each /verify round publish and update only its own status comment instead of overwriting other verification comments. ([#15988](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15988)) by @wenshao - Fixes deep-verification reports so the verdict line stays a plain paragraph and the published comment is verified against the intended body. ([#16002](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16002)) by @wenshao - Adds the missing development proxy for autofix-pr routes so the PR watches page reaches the daemon. ([#16004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16004)) by @wenshao - Updates MCP client and core to 2.4.0 to drop pre-bundled fast-uri 3.1.0 and improve dependency auditability. ([#15925](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15925)) by @yiliang114 - Uses the automatic GitHub job token for release publish checkout, reducing authentication failures while keeping PAT for branch push and release creation. ([#15730](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15730)) by @qwen-code-dev-bot - Adds isolation so /verify-pr mutation matrix runs in its own tree and never on live measured cells. ([#15999](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15999)) by @wenshao - Fixes /verify-pr PR badge binding when a flag is glued directly to the PR number, such as 15979--publish. ([#15987](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15987)) by @wenshao - Reports a registry that keeps changing during a write as PeerControllerError with code registry-changed and a retry message.
